delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial choices are independent of overlap scores. No minimum-change quota. Independent review has not occurred.

verses.rationale: Keep title and lifted life as an act of trust.
verses.before: Of David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
verses.after: Of David. To you, LORD, I lift up my life.
verses.tsw_comparator: Of David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

verses.rationale: Clarify the object of enemy triumph without erasing shame.
verses.before: My God, in you I trust; let me not be put to shame; let not my enemies exult over me.
verses.after: My God, I trust in you. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies celebrate my downfall.
verses.tsw_comparator: My God, in you I trust; let me not be put to shame; let not my enemies exult over me.

verses.rationale: Preserve the contrast between waiting and groundless treachery.
verses.before: Indeed, none who wait for you will be put to shame; people who act treacherously without cause will be put to shame.
verses.after: Indeed, no one who waits for you will be put to shame. Let shame fall on those who betray others without cause.
verses.tsw_comparator: Indeed, none who wait for you will be put to shame; those who act treacherously without cause will be put to shame.

verses.rationale: Retain paired journey images and direct appeal.
verses.before: Make known to me your ways, LORD; teach me your paths.
verses.after: Show me your ways, LORD; teach me your paths.
verses.tsw_comparator: Make known to me your ways, LORD; teach me your paths.

verses.rationale: Connect guidance with rescue and sustained waiting.
verses.before: Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I wait all day long.
verses.after: Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God who saves me. I wait for you all day long.
verses.tsw_comparator: Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I wait all day long.

verses.rationale: Keep divine remembering and the antiquity of mercy.
verses.before: Remember your compassion, LORD, and your steadfast loves, for they have been from of old.
verses.after: Remember your compassion, LORD, and your faithful love; they have been yours from long ago.
verses.tsw_comparator: Remember your compassion, LORD, and your steadfast loves, for they have been from of old.

verses.rationale: Retain the threefold remembering contrast and acknowledged rebellion.
verses.before: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; according to your steadfast love, remember me, for the sake of your goodness, LORD.
verses.after: Do not remember my youthful sins or my rebellions. Remember me according to your faithful love, for the sake of your goodness, LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; according to your steadfast love, remember me, for the sake of your goodness, LORD.

verses.rationale: Make the causal link audible while retaining sinners as learners.
verses.before: Good and upright is the LORD; so he instructs sinners in the way.
verses.after: The LORD is good and upright; that is why he teaches sinners the way.
verses.tsw_comparator: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore he instructs sinners in the way.

verses.rationale: Preserve humble repeated and justice linked to guidance.
verses.before: He leads the humble in justice, and teaches the humble his way.
verses.after: He leads the humble in what is just and teaches the humble his way.
verses.tsw_comparator: He leads the humble in justice, and teaches the humble his way.

verses.rationale: Keep covenant and the relational qualification.
verses.before: All the paths of the LORD are steadfast love and faithfulness for people who keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.after: All the LORD’s paths are faithful love and truth for those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.tsw_comparator: All the paths of the LORD are steadfast love and faithfulness for those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.rationale: Preserve the greatness of guilt as part of the appeal.
verses.before: For the sake of your name, LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.after: For your name’s sake, LORD, forgive my wrongdoing, great as it is.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the sake of your name, LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.

verses.rationale: Clarify the teacher while leaving the choice’s agency open in a note.
verses.before: Who is the person who fears the LORD? He instructs them in the way he chooses.
verses.after: Who is the person who reveres the LORD? The LORD will teach that person the way to choose.
verses.tsw_comparator: Who is the person who fears the LORD? He instructs them in the way he chooses.

verses.rationale: Retain both present well-being and generational land promise.
verses.before: They themselves will dwell in goodness, and their offspring will inherit the land.
verses.after: That person will rest in well-being, and their offspring will inherit the land.
verses.tsw_comparator: They themselves will dwell in goodness, and their offspring will inherit the land.

verses.rationale: Render confidential council access naturally without reducing it to information.
verses.before: The counsel of the LORD is for people who fear him, and he makes his covenant known to them.
verses.after: The LORD shares his counsel with those who revere him; he makes his covenant known to them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The counsel of the LORD is for those who fear him, and he makes his covenant known to them.

verses.rationale: Keep eyes and trapped feet in their paired image.
verses.before: My eyes are always toward the LORD, for he brings my feet out of the net.
verses.after: My eyes are always turned toward the LORD, for he will free my feet from the net.
verses.tsw_comparator: My eyes are always toward the LORD, for he brings my feet out of the net.

verses.rationale: Preserve the speaker’s loneliness alongside affliction.
verses.before: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.
verses.after: Turn toward me and be gracious to me, for I am alone and afflicted.
verses.tsw_comparator: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

verses.rationale: Keep the ironic widening of trouble and release from constriction.
verses.before: The troubles of my heart have grown large; bring me out of my distresses.
verses.after: My heart’s troubles have grown wide; bring me out of my distress.
verses.tsw_comparator: The troubles of my heart have grown large; bring me out of my distresses.

verses.rationale: Retain suffering and sin together without declaring one caused the other.
verses.before: Look on my affliction and my trouble, and take away all my sins.
verses.after: Look at my affliction and hardship, and forgive all my sins.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look on my affliction and my trouble, and take away all my sins.

verses.rationale: Keep the repeated look and violent hatred.
verses.before: Look on my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with violent hatred.
verses.after: Look how many my enemies are, how violently they hate me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look on my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with violent hatred.

verses.rationale: Connect refuge with the appeal for life and honor.
verses.before: Guard my soul and rescue me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.
verses.after: Guard my life and rescue me. Do not let me be put to shame, for I have taken refuge in you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Guard my soul and rescue me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.

verses.rationale: Retain personified virtues and the waiting refrain.
verses.before: May integrity and uprightness guard me, for I wait for you.
verses.after: May integrity and uprightness guard me, for I wait for you.
verses.tsw_comparator: May integrity and uprightness guard me, for I wait for you.

verses.rationale: Preserve the final widening from individual to Israel.
verses.before: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its troubles.
verses.after: God, redeem Israel from all its troubles.
verses.tsw_comparator: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its troubles.

verses.rationale: Keep the title and integrity claim without claiming absolute sinlessness.
verses.before: Vindicate me, O LORD, for I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
verses.after: Of David. Vindicate me, LORD, for I have walked with integrity. I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
verses.tsw_comparator: Vindicate me, O LORD, for I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

verses.rationale: Follow the read imperative and preserve the ancient bodily image.
verses.before: Prove me, O LORD, and try me; test my heart and my mind.
verses.after: Examine me, LORD, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Prove me, O LORD, and try me; test my heart and my mind.

verses.rationale: Keep seeing and walking as sustained orientation.
verses.before: For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I walk in your truth.
verses.after: Your faithful love is before my eyes, and I walk in your truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I walk in your truth.

verses.rationale: Render concealed identity without inventing a named sect.
verses.before: I do not sit with men of falsehood, nor do I go with people who hide what they are.
verses.after: I do not sit with deceitful people or go along with those who hide what they are.
verses.tsw_comparator: I do not sit with men of falsehood, nor do I go with those who hide what they are.

verses.rationale: Retain the speaker’s hatred and refusal of company.
verses.before: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked.
verses.after: I hate the gathering of evildoers and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.tsw_comparator: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked.

verses.rationale: Preserve ritual and ethical imagery and continue into purpose.
verses.before: I wash my hands in innocence and go around your altar, O LORD,
verses.after: I wash my hands in innocence and walk around your altar, LORD,
verses.tsw_comparator: I wash my hands in innocence and go around your altar, O LORD,

verses.rationale: Keep the audible praise and full scope of wonders.
verses.before: proclaiming thanksgiving aloud and telling all your wondrous deeds.
verses.after: to raise a voice of thanksgiving and recount all your wonders.
verses.tsw_comparator: proclaiming thanksgiving aloud and telling all your wondrous deeds.

verses.rationale: Retain the repeated dwelling language.
verses.before: O LORD, I love the dwelling of your house and the place where your glory dwells.
verses.after: LORD, I love the house where you dwell, the place where your glory makes its home.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, I love the dwelling of your house and the place where your glory dwells.

verses.rationale: Make gathering in death readable and preserve bloodshed.
verses.before: Do not sweep away my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood,
verses.after: Do not sweep my life away with sinners, my life with men who shed blood,
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not sweep away my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood,

verses.rationale: Retain hands and specific corruption.
verses.before: in whose hands are schemes, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.after: whose hands are full of schemes and whose right hands overflow with bribes.
verses.tsw_comparator: in whose hands are schemes, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.rationale: Keep integrity alongside need for grace.
verses.before: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; redeem me and be gracious to me.
verses.after: But I will walk with integrity. Redeem me and be gracious to me.
verses.tsw_comparator: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; redeem me and be gracious to me.

verses.rationale: Conclude with secure footing and public praise.
verses.before: My foot stands on level ground; in the assembly I will bless the LORD.
verses.after: My feet stand on level ground; in the assemblies I will bless the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: My foot stands on level ground; in the assembly I will bless the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep the paired confidence questions and protective images.
verses.before: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom will I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life; of whom will I be afraid?
verses.after: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom should I fear? The LORD is my life’s stronghold—whom should I dread?
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.rationale: Preserve predatory violence and the enemies’ reversal.
verses.before: When the wicked draw near against me to devour my flesh— my adversaries and my enemies— they stumble and fall.
verses.after: When evildoers came at me to devour my flesh, my adversaries and enemies stumbled and fell.
verses.tsw_comparator: When the wicked draw near against me to devour my flesh— my adversaries and my enemies— they stumble and fall.

verses.rationale: Retain escalating threats and inward confidence.
verses.before: Though an army encamp against me, my heart will not fear; though war rise up against me, in this I will trust.
verses.after: Though an army camps against me, my heart will not fear. Though war rises against me, even then I will trust.
verses.tsw_comparator: Though an army encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war rise up against me, in this I will trust.

verses.rationale: Preserve singular desire and the uncertain seeking verb without reducing it to attendance.
verses.before: One thing I have asked of the LORD, this I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to look the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.
verses.after: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I seek: to dwell in the LORD’s house all my life, to gaze on the LORD’s beauty and seek him in his temple.
verses.tsw_comparator: One thing I have asked of the LORD, this I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.

verses.rationale: Retain three protective actions and concrete places.
verses.before: For he will hide me in his shelter in the day of trouble; he will conceal me under the cover of his tent; he will set me high upon a rock.
verses.after: On a day of trouble he will hide me in his shelter, conceal me in the cover of his tent, and lift me high onto a rock.
verses.tsw_comparator: For he will hide me in his shelter in the day of trouble; he will conceal me under the cover of his tent; he will set me high upon a rock.

verses.rationale: Keep raised head and sacrificial celebration.
verses.before: And now my head is lifted up above my enemies all around me, and I will offer in his tent sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make melody to the LORD.
verses.after: Now my head will rise above the enemies around me. In his tent I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: And now my head is lifted up above my enemies all around me, and I will offer in his tent sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make melody to the LORD.

verses.rationale: Let confidence turn to petition without smoothing the shift.
verses.before: Hear, O LORD, when I cry aloud; be gracious to me and answer me.
verses.after: Hear my voice when I call, LORD; be gracious to me and answer.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear, O LORD, when I cry aloud; be gracious to me and answer me.

verses.rationale: Preserve difficult shifts of speaker and person with a note.
verses.before: You have said, “Seek my face.” My heart says to you, “Your face, LORD, do I seek.”
verses.after: My heart speaks for you: “Seek my face.” Your face, LORD, I will seek.
verses.tsw_comparator: You have said, “Seek my face.” My heart says to you, “Your face, LORD, do I seek.”

verses.rationale: Keep repeated abandonment appeals and remembered help.
verses.before: Do not hide your face from me; do not turn your servant away in anger, you who have been my help. Do not cast me off, do not forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.after: Do not hide your face from me or turn your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Do not abandon or forsake me, God who saves me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not hide your face from me; do not turn your servant away in anger, you who have been my help. Do not cast me off, do not forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.rationale: Retain the extremity of parental loss and divine welcome.
verses.before: If my father and my mother forsake me, the LORD will take me up.
verses.after: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will take me in.
verses.tsw_comparator: If my father and my mother forsake me, the LORD will take me up.

verses.rationale: Clarify hostile watchers while keeping the path image.
verses.before: Teach me your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path because of people who watch me.
verses.after: Teach me your way, LORD; lead me on a level path because of those watching for my fall.
verses.tsw_comparator: Teach me your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path because of those who watch me.

verses.rationale: Keep judicial threat and the breath image.
verses.before: Do not give me up to the will of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen against me and they breathe out violence.
verses.after: Do not hand me over to my adversaries’ desires. False witnesses have risen against me, breathing violence.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not give me up to the will of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen against me and they breathe out violence.

verses.rationale: Preserve the marked Hebrew conditional and unfinished sentence.
verses.before: I believe that I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.after: If I had not trusted that I would see the LORD’s goodness in the land of the living—
verses.tsw_comparator: I believe that I shall see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.rationale: Retain the repeated summons and inward courage.
verses.before: Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart take courage; wait for the LORD.
verses.after: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Wait for the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart take courage; wait for the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep hearing/silence contrast and the threat of death.
verses.before: Of David. To you, LORD, I call; my rock, do not be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I become like people who go down to the Pit.
verses.after: Of David. To you I call, LORD, my rock. Do not be deaf to me. If you stay silent, I will be like those who descend to the pit.
verses.tsw_comparator: Of David. To you, LORD, I call; my rock, do not be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I become like those who go down to the Pit.

verses.rationale: Clarify the temple location while preserving raised hands.
verses.before: Hear the voice of my pleas when I cry to you for help, when I lift my hands toward your holy inner sanctuary.
verses.after: Hear my plea for mercy when I cry to you, when I lift my hands toward your holy inner sanctuary.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear the voice of my pleas when I cry to you for help, when I lift my hands toward your holy inner sanctuary.

verses.rationale: Retain deceptive peace and the request for distinct treatment.
verses.before: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with people who work iniquity, who speak peace with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.
verses.after: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with evildoers, who speak peace to their neighbors while harboring evil.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who work iniquity, who speak peace with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.

verses.rationale: Keep the insistent repetitions of retribution.
verses.before: Give them according to their work, according to the evil of their deeds; according to the work of their hands, give to them; return their recompense to them.
verses.after: Give them what their deeds deserve, what their evil actions deserve. Repay the work of their hands; return to them what they have earned.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give them according to their work, according to the evil of their deeds; according to the work of their hands, give to them; return their recompense to them.

verses.rationale: Retain the human/divine hands contrast and building metaphor.
verses.before: For they do not understand the works of the LORD or the work of his hands. He will tear them down and not build them up.
verses.after: They pay no attention to the LORD’s deeds, to the work of his hands. He will tear them down and never build them up.
verses.tsw_comparator: For they do not understand the works of the LORD or the work of his hands. He will tear them down and not build them up.

verses.rationale: Keep the turn to answered prayer.
verses.before: Blessed be the LORD, for he has heard the voice of my pleas.
verses.after: Blessed be the LORD! He has heard my plea for mercy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed be the LORD, for he has heard the voice of my pleas.

verses.rationale: Preserve trust, help, and rejoicing in connected sequence.
verses.before: The LORD is my strength and my shield; in him my heart has trusted, and I have been helped. My heart exults, and with my song I will praise him.
verses.after: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusted him, and I was helped. My heart leaps for joy; with my song I thank him.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is my strength and my shield; in him my heart has trusted, and I have been helped. My heart exults, and with my song I will praise him.

verses.rationale: Retain pinned their rather than silently replacing it with his people.
verses.before: The LORD is strength for them; he is a stronghold of salvation for his anointed one.
verses.after: The LORD is their strength, a stronghold of salvation for his anointed.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is strength for them; he is a stronghold of salvation for his anointed one.

verses.rationale: Keep collective inheritance and the caring shepherd actions.
verses.before: Save your people and bless your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
verses.after: Save your people and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and carry them forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Save your people and bless your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.

verses.rationale: Preserve heavenly assembly language with explanatory vocabulary.
verses.before: A psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of gods; ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.after: A psalm of David. Give the LORD his due, you sons of gods; give the LORD glory and strength.
verses.tsw_comparator: A psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of gods; ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

verses.rationale: Keep liturgical repetition and ambiguous holy adornment.
verses.before: Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name; bow down to the LORD in holy splendor.
verses.after: Give the LORD the glory of his name; bow before the LORD in holy splendor.
verses.tsw_comparator: Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name; bow down to the LORD in holy splendor.

verses.rationale: Preserve voice/thunder parallelism and repeated waters.
verses.before: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is over mighty waters.
verses.after: The LORD’s voice is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the LORD over mighty waters.
verses.tsw_comparator: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is over mighty waters.

verses.rationale: Retain the central repeated subject.
verses.before: The voice of the LORD is in power; the voice of the LORD is in majesty.
verses.after: The LORD’s voice is powerful; the LORD’s voice is majestic.
verses.tsw_comparator: The voice of the LORD is in power; the voice of the LORD is in majesty.

verses.rationale: Keep specific trees and region with intensified action.
verses.before: The voice of the LORD breaks cedars; the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.after: The LORD’s voice breaks cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.tsw_comparator: The voice of the LORD breaks cedars; the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.rationale: Keep mountains personified as leaping animals.
verses.before: He makes them skip like a calf— Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.after: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.tsw_comparator: He makes them skip like a calf— Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.

verses.rationale: Preserve the striking lightning-like image without replacing it with an explanation.
verses.before: The voice of the LORD carves out flames of fire.
verses.after: The LORD’s voice cuts out flames of fire.
verses.tsw_comparator: The voice of the LORD carves out flames of fire.

verses.rationale: Retain repeated action and named wilderness.
verses.before: The voice of the LORD makes the wilderness writhe; the LORD makes the wilderness of Kadesh writhe.
verses.after: The LORD’s voice makes the wilderness writhe; the LORD makes the wilderness of Kadesh writhe.
verses.tsw_comparator: The voice of the LORD makes the wilderness writhe; the LORD makes the wilderness of Kadesh writhe.

verses.rationale: Follow pointed deer reading and retain the cosmic acclamation.
verses.before: The voice of the LORD brings does to birth and strips forests bare; and in his temple, all say, “Glory!”
verses.after: The LORD’s voice brings deer into labor and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything cries, “Glory!”
verses.tsw_comparator: The voice of the LORD brings does to birth and strips forests bare; and in his temple, all say, “Glory!”

verses.rationale: Keep the flood term and past-to-enduring kingship.
verses.before: The LORD sat enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits enthroned as king forever.
verses.after: The LORD sat enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits as king forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD sat enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits enthroned as king forever.

verses.rationale: Read the concluding imperfects as blessing while retaining strength and peace.
verses.before: May the LORD give strength to his people; may the LORD bless his people with peace.
verses.after: May the LORD give strength to his people; may the LORD bless his people with peace.
verses.tsw_comparator: May the LORD give strength to his people; may the LORD bless his people with peace.

verses.rationale: Include the entire title and the lifting wordplay.
verses.before: I will exalt you, LORD, for you have drawn me up and have not made my enemies rejoice over me.
verses.after: A psalm. A song for the dedication of the house. Of David. I will lift you high, LORD, for you drew me up and did not let my enemies rejoice over me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will exalt you, LORD, for you have drawn me up and have not made my enemies rejoice over me.

verses.rationale: Keep the direct sequence of appeal and healing.
verses.before: LORD my God, I cried out to you, and you healed me.
verses.after: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you healed me.
verses.tsw_comparator: LORD my God, I cried out to you, and you healed me.

verses.rationale: Follow read my going down and retain Sheol alongside pit.
verses.before: LORD, you brought up my life from Sheol; you kept me alive from going down to the Pit.
verses.after: LORD, you brought my life up from Sheol; you kept me alive, saving me from going down to the pit.
verses.tsw_comparator: LORD, you brought up my life from Sheol; you kept me alive from going down to the Pit.

verses.rationale: Preserve the communal summons and holy remembrance expression.
verses.before: Sing praises to the LORD, you faithful ones, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.after: Sing praise to the LORD, you faithful ones; give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Sing praises to the LORD, you faithful ones, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.rationale: Keep duration contrast and weeping as an overnight guest.
verses.before: For his anger is for a moment; his favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may lodge for the evening, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verses.after: His anger lasts a moment; his favor brings a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but a cry of joy comes with morning.
verses.tsw_comparator: For his anger is for a moment; his favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may lodge for the evening, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

verses.rationale: Mark remembered confidence as the speaker’s earlier claim.
verses.before: As for me, I said in my security, “I will never be shaken.”
verses.after: When I was secure, I said, “I will never be shaken.”
verses.tsw_comparator: As for me, I said in my security, “I will never be shaken.”

verses.rationale: Preserve the difficult mountain image and sudden vulnerability.
verses.before: LORD, by your favor you made my mountain stand strong. You hid your face; I was dismayed.
verses.after: LORD, in your favor you made my mountain stand strong. You hid your face, and I was terrified.
verses.tsw_comparator: LORD, by your favor you made my mountain stand strong. You hid your face; I was dismayed.

verses.rationale: Distinguish divine name and Adonai title.
verses.before: To you, LORD, I called; to the Lord I pleaded for grace:
verses.after: To you, LORD, I called; to the Lord I pleaded:
verses.tsw_comparator: To you, LORD, I called; to the Lord I pleaded for grace:

verses.rationale: Retain the appeal against death and the voice of dust.
verses.before: “What gain is there in my blood, in my going down to the Pit? Will dust give you thanks? Will it declare your faithfulness?
verses.after: “What gain is there in my blood, in my going down to the pit? Will the dust thank you? Will it tell of your faithfulness?
verses.tsw_comparator: “What gain is there in my blood, in my going down to the Pit? Will dust give you thanks? Will it declare your faithfulness?

verses.rationale: Keep repeated address and close the plea.
verses.before: Hear, LORD, and be gracious to me; LORD, be my helper.”
verses.after: Hear, LORD, and be gracious to me. LORD, be my help!”
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear, LORD, and be gracious to me; LORD, be my helper.”

verses.rationale: Preserve the changing garments and embodied reversal.
verses.before: You turned my mourning into dancing for me; you loosened my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
verses.after: You turned my mourning into dancing; you loosened my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
verses.tsw_comparator: You turned my mourning into dancing for me; you loosened my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

verses.rationale: Keep pinned glory with a note and the purpose of renewed life.
verses.before: so that glory may sing praise to you and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever.
verses.after: so my glory may sing to you and not be silent. LORD my God, I will thank you forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that glory may sing praise to you and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever.

verses.rationale: Bind title and opening appeal; retain righteousness as ground of rescue.
verses.before: In you, O LORD, I take refuge; let me never be put to shame. In your righteousness deliver me.
verses.after: For the music leader. A psalm of David. In you, LORD, I take refuge; never let me be put to shame. Rescue me in your righteousness.
verses.tsw_comparator: In you, O LORD, I take refuge; let me never be put to shame. In your righteousness deliver me.

verses.rationale: Keep bodily listening and defensive images.
verses.before: Incline your ear to me; rescue me quickly. Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to save me.
verses.after: Bend your ear toward me; hurry to rescue me. Be my rock of refuge, a fortress to save me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Incline your ear to me; rescue me quickly. Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to save me.

verses.rationale: Retain remembered protection as reason for guidance.
verses.before: For you are my rock and my fortress; for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
verses.after: You are my crag and my fortress. For your name’s sake, lead me and guide me.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you are my rock and my fortress; for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

verses.rationale: Keep concealed danger and direct trust.
verses.before: Take me out of the net they have hidden for me, for you are my refuge.
verses.after: Free me from the net they hid for me, for you are my stronghold.
verses.tsw_comparator: Take me out of the net they have hidden for me, for you are my refuge.

verses.rationale: Preserve entrusted spirit without importing a later narrative setting.
verses.before: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O LORD, faithful God.
verses.after: Into your hand I entrust my spirit. You have redeemed me, LORD, faithful God.
verses.tsw_comparator: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O LORD, faithful God.

verses.rationale: Retain pinned first-person hatred and contrast of allegiances.
verses.before: I hate people who cling to worthless idols, but I trust in the LORD.
verses.after: I hate those who cling to empty idols; my trust is in the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but I trust in the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep seeing and knowing as attentive divine response.
verses.before: I will rejoice and be glad in your steadfast love, for you have seen my affliction; you have known the distress of my whole being.
verses.after: I will rejoice and be glad in your faithful love. You have seen my affliction; you know my life’s distress.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will rejoice and be glad in your steadfast love, for you have seen my affliction; you have known the distress of my whole being.

verses.rationale: Preserve confinement and spacious freedom.
verses.before: You have not handed me over to the enemy; you have set my feet in a broad place.
verses.after: You have not shut me into the enemy’s hand; you have set my feet in a broad place.
verses.tsw_comparator: You have not handed me over to the enemy; you have set my feet in a broad place.

verses.rationale: Retain embodied exhaustion across the whole person.
verses.before: Be gracious to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eye wastes away from grief, my soul and my body also.
verses.after: Be gracious to me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eyes waste away with grief, my whole being and my body too.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be gracious to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eye wastes away from grief, my soul and my body also.

verses.rationale: Keep pinned guilt rather than substituting affliction.
verses.before: For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with groaning; my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones waste away.
verses.after: My life drains away in sorrow, my years in sighing. My strength fails because of my wrongdoing; my bones waste away.
verses.tsw_comparator: For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with groaning; my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones waste away.

verses.rationale: Preserve the widening social rejection.
verses.before: Because of all my foes I have become a reproach, especially to my neighbors, and an object of dread to my acquaintances; people who see me in the street flee from me.
verses.after: Because of all my foes I have become an object of scorn, especially to my neighbors, a terror to my acquaintances. Those who see me outside flee from me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Because of all my foes I have become a reproach, especially to my neighbors, and an object of dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.

verses.rationale: Keep forgotten death and discarded-object imagery.
verses.before: I have been forgotten like one dead; I have become like a broken vessel.
verses.after: I have slipped from memory like someone dead; I am like a broken vessel.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have been forgotten like one dead; I have become like a broken vessel.

verses.rationale: Retain fear refrain and lethal conspiracy.
verses.before: For I hear the whispering of many— terror on every side!— as they scheme together against me, as they plot to take my life.
verses.after: I hear the whispering of many—terror on every side! They gather against me and plot to take my life.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I hear the whispering of many— terror on every side!— as they scheme together against me, as they plot to take my life.

verses.rationale: Keep the explicit turn toward trust.
verses.before: Yet I trust in you, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
verses.after: But I trust in you, LORD. I say, “You are my God.”
verses.tsw_comparator: But I trust in you, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”

verses.rationale: Retain contrasted hands and the open meaning of times.
verses.before: My times are in your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and persecutors.
verses.after: My times are in your hand. Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and pursuers.
verses.tsw_comparator: My times are in your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and persecutors.

verses.rationale: Preserve the blessing image in a personal plea.
verses.before: Make your face shine on your servant; save me in your steadfast love.
verses.after: Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your faithful love.
verses.tsw_comparator: Make your face shine on your servant; save me in your steadfast love.

verses.rationale: Keep the severe reversal and realm of death.
verses.before: O LORD, let me not be put to shame, for I call on you; let the wicked be put to shame; let them go silently to Sheol.
verses.after: LORD, do not let me be put to shame, for I call on you. Let the wicked be ashamed and fall silent in Sheol.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, let me not be put to shame, for I call on you; let the wicked be put to shame; let them go silently to Sheol.

verses.rationale: Retain the nature and target of hostile speech.
verses.before: Let lying lips be mute, which speak arrogantly against the righteous with pride and contempt.
verses.after: Silence lying lips that speak insolently against the righteous with pride and contempt.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let lying lips be mute, which speak arrogantly against the righteous with pride and contempt.

verses.rationale: Keep stored goodness becoming publicly visible.
verses.before: Oh, how great is your goodness, which you have stored up for people who fear you, which you have worked for people who take refuge in you, in the sight of the children of humanity!
verses.after: How abundant is the goodness you have stored up for those who revere you, which you show to those who take refuge in you, before all people!
verses.tsw_comparator: Oh, how great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, in the sight of the children of humanity!

verses.rationale: Preserve shelter repeated and speech as a threat.
verses.before: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from human schemes; you keep them safe in your dwelling from accusing tongues.
verses.after: You hide them in the shelter of your presence from human plots; you keep them safe in a shelter from quarreling tongues.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from human schemes; you keep them safe in your dwelling from accusing tongues.

verses.rationale: Choose besieged rather than fortified and note the ambiguity.
verses.before: Blessed be the LORD, for he has shown his steadfast love to me when I was as in a besieged city.
verses.after: Blessed be the LORD! He showed me wondrous faithful love in a besieged city.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed be the LORD, for he has shown his steadfast love to me when I was as in a besieged city.

verses.rationale: Retain the contrast between fearful perception and being heard.
verses.before: As for me, I said in my alarm, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Even so you heard the voice of my pleas for mercy when I cried to you for help.
verses.after: In my panic I said, “I am cut off from your sight!” Yet you heard my plea when I cried to you for help.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for me, I said in my alarm, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my pleas for mercy when I cried to you for help.

verses.rationale: Keep communal appeal and asymmetric outcomes.
verses.before: Love the LORD, all you his faithful ones! The LORD preserves the faithful but repays the one who acts proudly in full.
verses.after: Love the LORD, all you faithful ones. The LORD guards the faithful and repays the proud in full.
verses.tsw_comparator: Love the LORD, all you his faithful ones! The LORD preserves the faithful but repays the one who acts proudly in full.

verses.rationale: Preserve the shared closing exhortation.
verses.before: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the LORD.
verses.after: Be strong, and let your hearts take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the LORD.

verses.rationale: Retain title and two images of forgiveness.
verses.before: Happy are those whose rebellion is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.after: Of David. A maskil. Happy is the one whose rebellion is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.tsw_comparator: Happy are those whose rebellion is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.rationale: Clarify accounting idiom while preserving inner honesty.
verses.before: Happy are those to whom the LORD does not count iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.after: Happy is the person whose wrongdoing the LORD does not count against them, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.tsw_comparator: Happy are those to whom the LORD does not count iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.

verses.rationale: Retain the paradox of silence and anguished noise.
verses.before: While I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
verses.after: When I kept silent, my bones wore out through my groaning all day long.
verses.tsw_comparator: While I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

verses.rationale: Keep heavy hand and drying life imagery.
verses.before: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was dried up as by the heat of summer. Selah
verses.after: Day and night your hand weighed on me; my vitality dried up in summer’s heat. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was dried up as by the heat of summer. Selah

verses.rationale: Preserve cover/uncover contrast and confession followed by forgiveness.
verses.before: Then I acknowledged my sin to you, and I did not hide my iniquity; I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
verses.after: I made my sin known to you; I did not cover my wrongdoing. I said, “I will confess my rebellions to the LORD,” and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I acknowledged my sin to you, and I did not hide my iniquity; I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

verses.rationale: Supply found object cautiously and retain flood protection.
verses.before: So let everyone who are faithful offer prayer to you at a time when you may be found; surely the rush of mighty waters will not reach them.
verses.after: So let everyone faithful pray to you while you may be found. When mighty waters flood, they will not reach that person.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore let all who are faithful offer prayer to you at a time when you may be found; surely the rush of mighty waters shall not reach them.

verses.rationale: Keep surrounding songs and protective refuge.
verses.before: You are a hiding place for me; you preserve me from trouble; you surround me with shouts of deliverance. Selah
verses.after: You are my hiding place. You guard me from distress; you surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: You are a hiding place for me; you preserve me from trouble; you surround me with shouts of deliverance. Selah

verses.rationale: Leave the unmarked speaker open and preserve watchful counsel.
verses.before: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will counsel you with my eye upon you.
verses.after: I will give you insight and teach you the way to go; I will counsel you with my eye upon you.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will counsel you with my eye upon you.

verses.rationale: Retain animal restraint and difficult final relation.
verses.before: Do not be like a horse or a mule, without understanding, whose temper must be curbed with bit and bridle, else it will not stay near you.
verses.after: Do not be like a horse or mule without understanding, held in check by bit and bridle, or it will not come near you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not be like a horse or a mule, without understanding, whose temper must be curbed with bit and bridle, else it will not stay near you.

verses.rationale: Keep the contrast and surrounding motif.
verses.before: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but steadfast love surrounds people who trust in the LORD.
verses.after: The wicked have many sorrows, but faithful love surrounds the one who trusts the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but steadfast love surrounds those who trust in the LORD.

verses.rationale: Retain both groups in the communal invitation.
verses.before: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous, and shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
verses.after: Rejoice in the LORD and be glad, you righteous; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous, and shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

verses.rationale: Preserve the call and its stated suitability.
verses.before: Shout for joy in the LORD, O righteous; praise befits the upright.
verses.after: Shout for joy in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.tsw_comparator: Shout for joy in the LORD, O righteous; praise befits the upright.

verses.rationale: Keep instrument distinction and number.
verses.before: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre; make melody to him with the harp of ten strings.
verses.after: Thank the LORD with the lyre; make music to him on a ten-stringed harp.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre; make melody to him with the harp of ten strings.

verses.rationale: Retain newness and skilled audible celebration.
verses.before: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully with loud shouts.
verses.after: Sing him a new song; play skillfully, with shouts of joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully with loud shouts.

verses.rationale: Keep word and work in parallel.
verses.before: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.after: The LORD’s word is upright; all his work is done faithfully.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all his work is done in faithfulness.

verses.rationale: Retain the three linked moral and relational terms.
verses.before: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the steadfast love of the LORD.
verses.after: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the LORD’s faithful love.
verses.tsw_comparator: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the steadfast love of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep speech and breath as creation imagery.
verses.before: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their host.
verses.after: By the LORD’s word the heavens were made, and all their host by the breath of his mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their host.

verses.rationale: Preserve pinned heap and ancient spatial images.
verses.before: He gathers the waters of the sea as a heap; he puts the deeps in storehouses.
verses.after: He gathers the sea’s waters into a heap; he places the deeps in storehouses.
verses.tsw_comparator: He gathers the waters of the sea as a heap; he puts the deeps in storehouses.

verses.rationale: Keep universal scope and paired reverent responses.
verses.before: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.after: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let everyone in the world stand in awe of him.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.rationale: Retain concise divine speech and resulting existence.
verses.before: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.after: He spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.tsw_comparator: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.

verses.rationale: Preserve counsel/plans as repeated terms for later contrast.
verses.before: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; he frustrates the plans of the peoples.
verses.after: The LORD frustrates the nations’ counsel and thwarts the peoples’ plans.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; he frustrates the plans of the peoples.

verses.rationale: Retain the contrast of enduring divine purpose.
verses.before: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the plans of his heart to all generations.
verses.after: The LORD’s counsel stands forever, the plans of his heart through every generation.
verses.tsw_comparator: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the plans of his heart to all generations.

verses.rationale: Keep election and inheritance without substituting a modern nation.
verses.before: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen as his heritage.
verses.after: Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose as his own inheritance.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen as his heritage.

verses.rationale: Preserve the comprehensive divine gaze.
verses.before: The LORD looks down from heaven; he sees all the children of man;
verses.after: The LORD looks down from heaven and sees all humanity.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD looks down from heaven; he sees all the children of man;

verses.rationale: Continue the same gaze across the verse boundary.
verses.before: from where he sits enthroned he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.after: From his dwelling place he watches everyone who lives on earth—
verses.tsw_comparator: from where he sits enthroned he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

verses.rationale: Keep shared formation and individual actions.
verses.before: he who forms the hearts of them all and considers all their deeds.
verses.after: he who forms all their hearts and understands everything they do.
verses.tsw_comparator: he who forms the hearts of them all and considers all their deeds.

verses.rationale: Retain the two human power claims denied.
verses.before: The king is not saved by his great army; a warrior is not delivered by his great strength.
verses.after: A king is not saved by a great army; a warrior does not escape by great strength.
verses.tsw_comparator: The king is not saved by his great army; a warrior is not delivered by his great strength.

verses.rationale: Keep military horse and insufficiency of strength.
verses.before: The war horse is a false hope for salvation, and by its great might it cannot rescue.
verses.after: A horse is a false hope for victory; its great power cannot bring escape.
verses.tsw_comparator: The war horse is a false hope for salvation, and by its great might it cannot rescue.

verses.rationale: Retain the eye image and waiting recipients.
verses.before: Look, the eye of the LORD is on people who fear him, on people who hope in his steadfast love,
verses.after: Look, the LORD’s eye is on those who revere him, on those who hope in his faithful love,
verses.tsw_comparator: Behold, the eye of the LORD is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his steadfast love,

verses.rationale: Preserve two concrete threats to life.
verses.before: to deliver their soul from death and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.after: to rescue their lives from death and keep them alive in famine.
verses.tsw_comparator: to deliver their soul from death and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.rationale: Mark the shift into shared first-person trust.
verses.before: Our soul waits for the LORD; he is our help and our shield.
verses.after: We wait for the LORD; he is our help and our shield.
verses.tsw_comparator: Our soul waits for the LORD; he is our help and our shield.

verses.rationale: Connect rejoicing with trust without removing name language.
verses.before: For our heart is glad in him, because we trust in his holy name.
verses.after: Our hearts rejoice in him, for we trust in his holy name.
verses.tsw_comparator: For our heart is glad in him, because we trust in his holy name.

verses.rationale: Keep the responsive relation of hope and petition.
verses.before: Let your steadfast love, O LORD, be upon us, even as we hope in you.
verses.after: Let your faithful love rest on us, LORD, as we place our hope in you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let your steadfast love, O LORD, be upon us, even as we hope in you.

verses.rationale: Retain the title’s Abimelech without harmonizing to Achish.
verses.before: I will bless the LORD at all times; his praise will continually be in my mouth.
verses.after: Of David, when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he left. I will bless the LORD at all times; his praise will always be in my mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will bless the LORD at all times; his praise will continually be in my mouth.

verses.rationale: Keep personal testimony inviting humble hearers.
verses.before: My whole being will boast in the LORD; the humble will hear and rejoice.
verses.after: I will boast in the LORD; let the humble hear and be glad.
verses.tsw_comparator: My whole being will boast in the LORD; the humble will hear and rejoice.

verses.rationale: Retain corporate praise and raised name.
verses.before: Magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.after: Magnify the LORD with me; let us lift his name high together.
verses.tsw_comparator: Magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.rationale: Preserve seeking, answer, and comprehensive rescue.
verses.before: I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.
verses.after: I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he rescued me from everything I feared.
verses.tsw_comparator: I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

verses.rationale: Express radiance without losing face/shame imagery.
verses.before: They looked to him and were radiant, and their faces will not be ashamed.
verses.after: Those who look to him shine with joy; their faces need never be ashamed.
verses.tsw_comparator: They looked to him and were radiant, and their faces will not be ashamed.

verses.rationale: Keep the speaker’s demonstrative testimony and singular sufferer.
verses.before: This poor one cried, and the LORD heard; he saved him from all his troubles.
verses.after: This afflicted person cried out, and the LORD heard; he saved him from all his troubles.
verses.tsw_comparator: This poor one cried, and the LORD heard; he saved him from all his troubles.

verses.rationale: Retain encampment and messenger without a later identification.
verses.before: The angel of the LORD encamps around people who fear him, and rescues them.
verses.after: The LORD’s messenger camps around those who revere him and rescues them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him, and rescues them.

verses.rationale: Retain the memorable sensory invitation.
verses.before: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.
verses.after: Taste and see that the LORD is good. Happy is the one who takes refuge in him.
verses.tsw_comparator: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.

verses.rationale: Keep repeated reverence and broad wisdom claim.
verses.before: Fear the LORD, you his holy ones, for people who fear him have no lack.
verses.after: Revere the LORD, you his holy ones; those who revere him lack nothing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Fear the LORD, you his holy ones, for those who fear him have no lack.

verses.rationale: Retain animal contrast and the poem’s unqualified promise.
verses.before: Young lions suffer want and hunger, but people who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
verses.after: Young lions go hungry and lack food, but those who seek the LORD will lack no good thing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Young lions suffer want and hunger, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

verses.rationale: Preserve the teacher’s familial address.
verses.before: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.after: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you reverence for the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep the rhetorical invitation before instruction.
verses.before: Who is the person who desires life, who loves days in order to see good?
verses.after: Who desires life and loves to see good days?
verses.tsw_comparator: Who is the person who desires life, who loves days in order to see good?

verses.rationale: Retain paired speech organs and responsibility.
verses.before: Guard your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.after: Guard your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
verses.tsw_comparator: Guard your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.

verses.rationale: Preserve active pursuit and balanced commands.
verses.before: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.after: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

verses.rationale: Keep attentive bodily imagery.
verses.before: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, and his ears toward their cry.
verses.after: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous, his ears toward their cry for help.
verses.tsw_comparator: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, and his ears toward their cry.

verses.rationale: Retain severe face and memory judgment.
verses.before: The face of the LORD is against people who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.after: The LORD’s face is against evildoers, to erase their memory from the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: The face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.rationale: Leave the resumed righteous referent as a pronoun with context intact.
verses.before: They cry out, and the LORD hears; from all their troubles he delivers them.
verses.after: They cry out, and the LORD hears; he rescues them from all their troubles.
verses.tsw_comparator: They cry out, and the LORD hears; from all their troubles he delivers them.

verses.rationale: Keep nearness and rescue as distinct responses.
verses.before: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted, and he saves those crushed in spirit.
verses.after: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted and saves those whose spirits are crushed.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted, and he saves those crushed in spirit.

verses.rationale: Preserve suffering alongside deliverance claim.
verses.before: Many are the troubles of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
verses.after: The righteous face many troubles, but the LORD rescues them from them all.
verses.tsw_comparator: Many are the troubles of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

verses.rationale: Retain bodily preservation without importing later fulfillment language.
verses.before: He guards all his bones; not one of them is broken.
verses.after: He guards all their bones; not one of them is broken.
verses.tsw_comparator: He guards all his bones; not one of them is broken.

verses.rationale: Keep evil as destructive agent and legal consequence.
verses.before: Evil will put the wicked to death, and people who hate the righteous will be held guilty.
verses.after: Evil will kill the wicked; those who hate the righteous will be held guilty.
verses.tsw_comparator: Evil will put the wicked to death, and those who hate the righteous will be held guilty.

verses.rationale: Repeat legal outcome in contrasting conclusion.
verses.before: The LORD redeems the life of his servants, and none of people who take refuge in him will be held guilty.
verses.after: The LORD redeems the lives of his servants; none who take refuge in him will be held guilty.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD redeems the life of his servants, and none of those who take refuge in him will be held guilty.

verses.rationale: Preserve matching legal and military appeals.
verses.before: Of David. Contend, LORD, with people who contend with me; fight against people who fight against me.
verses.after: Of David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me; fight those who fight me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Of David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

verses.rationale: Retain two defensive implements.
verses.before: Take up shield and buckler, and rise up to help me.
verses.after: Take up shield and great shield; rise to help me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Take up shield and buckler, and rise up to help me.

verses.rationale: Choose block as verb and make the reassurance audible.
verses.before: Draw spear and bar the way before people who pursue me. Say to my life, “I am your salvation.”
verses.after: Draw your spear and block the way of my pursuers. Say to me, “I am your salvation.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Draw spear and bar the way before those who pursue me. Say to my life, “I am your salvation.”

verses.rationale: Retain parallel wishes against attackers.
verses.before: Let people who seek my life be ashamed and disgraced; let people who devise evil against me turn back and be humiliated.
verses.after: Let those seeking my life be ashamed and disgraced; let those plotting my harm retreat in humiliation.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let those who seek my life be ashamed and disgraced; let those who devise evil against me turn back and be humiliated.

verses.rationale: Keep the windblown chaff and divine messenger.
verses.before: Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away.
verses.after: Let them be chaff before the wind, with the LORD’s messenger driving them away.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away.

verses.rationale: Retain pursuit and dangerous path imagery.
verses.before: Let their way be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.
verses.after: Let their path be dark and slippery, with the LORD’s messenger pursuing them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let their way be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.

verses.rationale: Retain twice-repeated causelessness and compressed trap image.
verses.before: For without cause they hid their net’s pit for me; without cause they dug it for my life.
verses.after: Without cause they hid their net in a pit for me; without cause they dug a trap for my life.
verses.tsw_comparator: For without cause they hid their net’s pit for me; without cause they dug it for my life.

verses.rationale: Make the singular enemy clear while preserving self-entrapment.
verses.before: Let ruin come upon them unawares; let the net they hid catch them; into that ruin let them fall.
verses.after: Let ruin catch the enemy unaware; let the net he hid catch him; let him fall into it, into ruin.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let ruin come upon them unawares; let the net they hid catch them; into that ruin let them fall.

verses.rationale: Keep personal response to deliverance.
verses.before: Then my life will rejoice in the LORD; it will exult in his salvation.
verses.after: Then I will rejoice in the LORD, delighting in his salvation.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then my life will rejoice in the LORD; it will exult in his salvation.

verses.rationale: Retain speaking bones and protection of vulnerable people.
verses.before: All my bones will say, “LORD, who is like you, delivering the poor from one stronger than they, the poor and needy from the one who robs them?”
verses.after: All my bones will say, “LORD, who is like you? You rescue the afflicted from those too strong for them, the afflicted and needy from the one who robs them.”
verses.tsw_comparator: All my bones will say, “LORD, who is like you, delivering the poor from one stronger than they, the poor and needy from the one who robs them?”

verses.rationale: Keep legal violence and unsupported accusations.
verses.before: Violent witnesses rise up; they ask me about things I do not know.
verses.after: Violent witnesses rise up; they question me about things I know nothing of.
verses.tsw_comparator: Violent witnesses rise up; they ask me about things I do not know.

verses.rationale: Preserve bereavement metaphor rather than generic sadness.
verses.before: They repay me evil for good— bereavement for my life.
verses.after: They repay my good with evil, leaving my life bereaved.
verses.tsw_comparator: They repay me evil for good— bereavement for my life.

verses.rationale: Retain difficult returning-prayer image for the note.
verses.before: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I afflicted my life with fasting, and my prayer kept returning to my bosom.
verses.after: Yet when they were ill, I wore sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting; my prayer returned to my bosom.
verses.tsw_comparator: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I afflicted my life with fasting, and my prayer kept returning to my bosom.

verses.rationale: Keep intimate relationships and embodied mourning.
verses.before: I went about as if for a friend, as if for a brother; as one mourning for a mother, I bowed down in grief.
verses.after: I went about as though grieving for a friend or brother; bowed in mourning, as for my mother.
verses.tsw_comparator: I went about as though for a friend, as though for a brother; as one mourning for a mother, I bowed down in grief.

verses.rationale: Retain contrast with prior care and uncertain attackers term.
verses.before: But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered; the afflicted gathered against me, though I did not know it. They tore at me without ceasing.
verses.after: But when I stumbled, they rejoiced and gathered; attackers I did not know gathered against me, tearing at me without stopping.
verses.tsw_comparator: But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered; the afflicted gathered against me, though I did not know it. They tore at me without ceasing.

verses.rationale: Choose feast reading of difficult phrase and preserve threat.
verses.before: Like godless mockers at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.after: Like godless mockers at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Like godless mockers at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.

verses.rationale: Retain accusation of delay and irreplaceable life.
verses.before: Lord, how long will you look on? Restore my life from their devastations, my only one from the young lions.
verses.after: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my life from their ravages, my only life from these young lions.
verses.tsw_comparator: Lord, how long will you look on? Restore my life from their devastations, my only one from the young lions.

verses.rationale: Preserve public setting and future thanksgiving.
verses.before: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among a mighty people I will praise you.
verses.after: I will thank you in the great assembly; among a mighty people I will praise you.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among a mighty people I will praise you.

verses.rationale: Keep collusive gesture and groundless hatred.
verses.before: Do not let my deceitful enemies rejoice over me; do not let people who hate me without cause wink the eye.
verses.after: Do not let my treacherous enemies rejoice over me or those who hate me without cause wink at one another.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not let my deceitful enemies rejoice over me; do not let those who hate me without cause wink the eye.

verses.rationale: Preserve harm to peaceful residents.
verses.before: For they do not speak peace; against the quiet ones of the land they devise deceitful words.
verses.after: They do not speak peace; they devise deceitful words against those living quietly in the land.
verses.tsw_comparator: For they do not speak peace; against the quiet ones of the land they devise deceitful words.

verses.rationale: Retain repeated taunt and claimed eyewitness evidence.
verses.before: They open their mouths wide against me; they say, “Aha! Aha! Our own eyes have seen it!”
verses.after: They open their mouths wide against me, saying, “Aha! Aha! Our own eyes saw it!”
verses.tsw_comparator: They open their mouths wide against me; they say, “Aha! Aha! Our own eyes have seen it!”

verses.rationale: Set God’s sight against hostile witnesses and retain two divine forms.
verses.before: You have seen, LORD; do not be silent. Lord, do not be far from me.
verses.after: You have seen, LORD; do not stay silent. Lord, do not remain far from me.
verses.tsw_comparator: You have seen, LORD; do not be silent. Lord, do not be far from me.

verses.rationale: Preserve urgent waking imagery and legal case.
verses.before: Awake and arise for my justice, my God and my Lord, for my cause.
verses.after: Wake up! Rise to defend my cause, my God and my Lord, to contend for me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Awake and arise for my justice, my God and my Lord, for my cause.

verses.rationale: Keep requested judgment grounded in divine righteousness.
verses.before: Judge me according to your righteousness, LORD my God, and do not let them rejoice over me.
verses.after: Vindicate me according to your righteousness, LORD my God; do not let them rejoice over me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Judge me according to your righteousness, LORD my God, and do not let them rejoice over me.

verses.rationale: Clarify inward speech and retain consuming image.
verses.before: Do not let them say in their hearts, “Aha, our desire!” Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up.”
verses.after: Do not let them think, “Aha! Just what we wanted!” Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him!”
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not let them say in their hearts, “Aha, our desire!” Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up.”

verses.rationale: Keep collective reversal and garment image.
verses.before: Let everyone who rejoice at my harm be ashamed and humiliated together; let people who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.
verses.after: Let all who rejoice at my harm be ashamed and humiliated; let those who exalt themselves over me wear shame and disgrace.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let all who rejoice at my harm be ashamed and humiliated together; let those who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.

verses.rationale: Retain supporters’ voice and divine delight in welfare.
verses.before: Let people who delight in my vindication shout for joy and rejoice; let them say continually, “Great is the LORD, who delights in the well-being of his servant.”
verses.after: Let those who desire my vindication shout for joy and be glad. Let them always say, “Great is the LORD, who delights in his servant’s well-being!”
verses.tsw_comparator: Let those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and rejoice; let them say continually, “Great is the LORD, who delights in the well-being of his servant.”

verses.rationale: Close with sustained speech and justice theme.
verses.before: Then my tongue will speak of your righteousness, of your praise all day long.
verses.after: My tongue will speak of your righteousness and praise you all day long.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then my tongue will speak of your righteousness, of your praise all day long.

verses.rationale: Keep pinned my heart and the difficult oracle construction.
verses.before: An utterance of transgression to the wicked is within my heart: there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.after: For the music leader. Of the LORD’s servant David. An oracle of rebellion concerning the wicked lies within my heart: there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.tsw_comparator: An utterance of transgression to the wicked is within my heart: there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.rationale: Choose self-flattery while documenting uncertain pronoun relations.
verses.before: For in his own eyes he flatters himself, too much to find his guilt and hate it.
verses.after: He flatters himself in his own eyes too much to recognize and hate his wrongdoing.
verses.tsw_comparator: For in his own eyes he flatters himself, too much to find his guilt and hate it.

verses.rationale: Retain deterioration in conduct, not merely ignorance.
verses.before: The words of his mouth are trouble and deceit; he has ceased to act wisely, to do good.
verses.after: His mouth speaks harm and deceit; he has stopped acting wisely and doing good.
verses.tsw_comparator: The words of his mouth are trouble and deceit; he has ceased to act wisely, to do good.

verses.rationale: Preserve planned wrongdoing and repeated moral refusal.
verses.before: He plans trouble on his bed; he sets himself on a way that is not good; evil he does not reject.
verses.after: He plots harm on his bed, sets himself on a way that is not good, and does not reject evil.
verses.tsw_comparator: He plans trouble on his bed; he sets himself on a way that is not good; evil he does not reject.

verses.rationale: Keep parallel expansive images and distinct related terms.
verses.before: LORD, your steadfast love is in the heavens, your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.after: LORD, your faithful love reaches the heavens, your faithfulness the clouds.
verses.tsw_comparator: LORD, your steadfast love is in the heavens, your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

verses.rationale: Retain mountains of God idiom and nonhuman beneficiaries.
verses.before: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judgments are a great deep. Human and beast you save, LORD.
verses.after: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains; your judgments are a vast deep. You save humans and animals, LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judgments are a great deep. Human and beast you save, LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep value and protective wings.
verses.before: How precious is your steadfast love, O God! The children of humankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
verses.after: How precious is your faithful love, God! People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
verses.tsw_comparator: How precious is your steadfast love, O God! The children of humankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings.

verses.rationale: Preserve abundant drinking and river imagery.
verses.before: They are filled from the abundance of your house, and you give them drink from the river of your delights.
verses.after: They drink their fill of your house’s abundance; you give them drink from your river of delights.
verses.tsw_comparator: They are filled from the abundance of your house, and you give them drink from the river of your delights.

verses.rationale: Keep repeated light and source of life image.
verses.before: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
verses.after: With you is the spring of life; in your light we see light.
verses.tsw_comparator: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.

verses.rationale: Retain relational knowledge and ethical recipients.
verses.before: Draw out your steadfast love to people who know you, and your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.after: Extend your faithful love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Draw out your steadfast love to those who know you, and your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.rationale: Preserve threatening foot and hand.
verses.before: Do not let the foot of pride come against me; do not let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.after: Do not let the foot of pride come upon me or the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not let the foot of pride come against me; do not let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.rationale: Keep the sudden vision of completed defeat.
verses.before: There the workers of trouble have fallen; they are thrust down and cannot rise.
verses.after: There the evildoers have fallen, thrown down, unable to rise.
verses.tsw_comparator: There the workers of trouble have fallen; they are thrust down and cannot rise.

verses.rationale: Render heat idiom and retain envy as a distinct danger.
verses.before: Of David. Do not burn with anger because of evildoers; do not be envious of people who do wrong.
verses.after: Of David. Do not burn with anger over evildoers or envy those who do wrong.
verses.tsw_comparator: Of David. Do not burn with anger because of evildoers; do not be envious of those who do wrong.

verses.rationale: Preserve fleeting vegetation imagery.
verses.before: For like grass they will quickly wither; like green plants they will fade away.
verses.after: They will soon wither like grass and fade like green plants.
verses.tsw_comparator: For like grass they will quickly wither; like green plants they will fade away.

verses.rationale: Keep difficult grazing image and document alternatives.
verses.before: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and tend faithfulness.
verses.after: Trust the LORD and do good. Live in the land and feed on faithfulness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and tend faithfulness.

verses.rationale: Retain delight and promise without inserting conditions.
verses.before: Delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.after: Take delight in the LORD, and he will give you your heart’s desires.
verses.tsw_comparator: Delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

verses.rationale: Render rolling one’s way naturally while preserving agency.
verses.before: Roll your way upon the LORD; trust in him, and he will act.
verses.after: Entrust your way to the LORD; trust him, and he will act.
