verses.tsw_comparator: Roll your way upon the LORD; trust in him, and he will act.

verses.rationale: Keep public vindication and increasing brightness.
verses.before: He will bring forth your righteousness like the light, your justice like the noonday.
verses.after: He will bring your righteousness out like light, your vindication like the midday sun.
verses.tsw_comparator: He will bring forth your righteousness like the light, your justice like the noonday.

verses.rationale: Connect prosperity to scheming without flattening waiting.
verses.before: Be still before the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Do not burn with anger at one who prospers in his way, at one who carries out schemes.
verses.after: Be still before the LORD and wait for him. Do not burn with anger over someone who prospers by carrying out evil schemes.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be still before the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Do not burn with anger at one who prospers in his way, at one who carries out schemes.

verses.rationale: Preserve the warning about anger’s consequence.
verses.before: Let go of anger and abandon wrath; do not burn with anger—it leads only to evil.
verses.after: Let go of anger; leave fury behind. Do not burn with resentment—it only leads to harm.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let go of anger and abandon wrath; do not burn with anger—it leads only to evil.

verses.rationale: Keep land promise and repeated waiting.
verses.before: For evildoers will be cut off, but people who wait for the LORD will inherit the land.
verses.after: Evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD will inherit the land.
verses.tsw_comparator: For evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD will inherit the land.

verses.rationale: Retain invitation to inspect their disappearance.
verses.before: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; you will look carefully at their place, and they will not be there.
verses.after: A little while, and the wicked will be gone. Look closely at their place: they are no longer there.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; you will look carefully at their place, and they will not be there.

verses.rationale: Preserve humble, inheritance, and well-being together.
verses.before: But the humble will inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace.
verses.after: The humble will inherit the land and delight in abundant peace.
verses.tsw_comparator: But the humble will inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace.

verses.rationale: Keep hostile intention and bodily threat.
verses.before: The wicked plots against the righteous and grinds his teeth at him.
verses.after: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked plots against the righteous and grinds his teeth at him.

verses.rationale: Distinguish Adonai and preserve approaching reckoning.
verses.before: The Lord laughs at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.after: The Lord laughs at the wicked, for he sees their day approaching.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Lord laughs at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

verses.rationale: Keep vulnerable victims and actual lethal violence.
verses.before: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent their bow, to bring down the poor and needy, to slaughter those upright in their way.
verses.after: The wicked draw their swords and bend their bows to bring down the afflicted and needy, to slaughter those who walk uprightly.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent their bow, to bring down the poor and needy, to slaughter those upright in their way.

verses.rationale: Preserve reversal onto the attackers.
verses.before: Their sword will enter their own heart, and their bows will be broken.
verses.after: Their swords will enter their own hearts, and their bows will break.
verses.tsw_comparator: Their sword will enter their own heart, and their bows will be broken.

verses.rationale: Retain quantity comparison without idealizing poverty.
verses.before: Better is the little that belongs to the righteous than the abundance of many wicked people.
verses.after: Better the little a righteous person has than the wealth of many wicked people.
verses.tsw_comparator: Better is the little that belongs to the righteous than the abundance of many wicked people.

verses.rationale: Keep power as arms and divine support.
verses.before: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
verses.after: The arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD supports the righteous.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

verses.rationale: Retain attentive knowing and enduring inheritance.
verses.before: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will endure forever.
verses.after: The LORD knows the days of the blameless; their inheritance will last forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will endure forever.

verses.rationale: Preserve concrete famine and sufficiency claim.
verses.before: They will not be put to shame in a time of evil; in days of famine they will be satisfied.
verses.after: They will not be put to shame in bad times; in days of famine they will have enough.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will not be put to shame in a time of evil; in days of famine they will be satisfied.

verses.rationale: Choose pasture reading of ambiguous term and retain doubled vanishing.
verses.before: But the wicked will perish, and the enemies of the LORD, like the glory of pasturelands, will vanish; in smoke they will vanish.
verses.after: But the wicked will perish. The LORD’s enemies are like the splendor of pastures: they vanish—vanish in smoke.
verses.tsw_comparator: But the wicked will perish, and the enemies of the LORD, like the glory of pasturelands, will vanish; in smoke they will vanish.

verses.rationale: Keep economic conduct as the ethical contrast.
verses.before: The wicked borrows and does not repay, but the righteous is gracious and gives.
verses.after: The wicked borrow and do not repay; the righteous give generously.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked borrows and does not repay, but the righteous is gracious and gives.

verses.rationale: Preserve blessing/curse parallel and implicit divine subject.
verses.before: For those blessed by him will inherit the land, but those cursed by him will be cut off.
verses.after: Those he blesses will inherit the land; those he curses will be cut off.
verses.tsw_comparator: For those blessed by him will inherit the land, but those cursed by him will be cut off.

verses.rationale: Clarify agency in the second clause, noting another reading.
verses.before: From the LORD a person's steps are established, and he delights in that person's way.
verses.after: The LORD makes a person’s steps secure and delights in that person’s way.
verses.tsw_comparator: From the LORD a person's steps are established, and he delights in that person's way.

verses.rationale: Keep stumble distinct from final collapse.
verses.before: Though one falls, one will not be thrown down, for the LORD supports their hand.
verses.after: Though they stumble, they will not be hurled down, for the LORD holds their hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: Though one falls, one will not be thrown down, for the LORD supports their hand.

verses.rationale: Retain personal testimony rather than changing it into a universal command.
verses.before: I was young, and now I am old, yet I have not seen the righteous abandoned, or their children begging for bread.
verses.after: I was young, and now I am old, yet I have not seen the righteous abandoned or their offspring searching for bread.
verses.tsw_comparator: I was young, and now I am old, yet I have not seen the righteous abandoned, or their children begging for bread.

verses.rationale: Preserve ongoing generosity and generational outcome.
verses.before: All day long they are gracious and lend, and their children are a blessing.
verses.after: They are always generous and lend freely; their offspring become a blessing.
verses.tsw_comparator: All day long they are gracious and lend, and their children are a blessing.

verses.rationale: Keep imperative and promised enduring residence.
verses.before: Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell forever.
verses.after: Turn from evil and do good, and dwell securely forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell forever.

verses.rationale: Retain the troubling generational contrast and pinned wording.
verses.before: For the LORD loves justice and does not abandon his faithful ones. They are kept forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
verses.after: The LORD loves justice and will not forsake his faithful ones. They are guarded forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD loves justice and does not abandon his faithful ones. They are kept forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.

verses.rationale: Preserve the repeated land refrain.
verses.before: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell upon it forever.
verses.after: The righteous will inherit the land and live there forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell upon it forever.

verses.rationale: Retain speech as ethical practice.
verses.before: The mouth of the righteous murmurs wisdom, and their tongue speaks justice.
verses.after: The righteous speak wisdom; their tongues speak what is just.
verses.tsw_comparator: The mouth of the righteous murmurs wisdom, and their tongue speaks justice.

verses.rationale: Link inward instruction and stable walking.
verses.before: The instruction of their God is in their heart; their steps do not slip.
verses.after: Their God’s instruction is in their hearts; their steps do not slip.
verses.tsw_comparator: The instruction of their God is in their heart; their steps do not slip.

verses.rationale: Keep surveillance and murderous aim.
verses.before: The wicked watches the righteous and seeks to put them to death.
verses.after: The wicked watch the righteous, looking for a way to kill them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked watches the righteous and seeks to put them to death.

verses.rationale: Retain courtroom setting and protective refusal.
verses.before: The LORD will not abandon them to his hand or condemn them when they are judged.
verses.after: The LORD will not abandon them to the wicked or let them be condemned when brought to trial.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD will not abandon them to his hand or condemn them when they are judged.

verses.rationale: Keep patience, conduct, inheritance, and observed judgment.
verses.before: Wait for the LORD and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
verses.after: Wait for the LORD and keep his way. He will raise you up to inherit the land; you will see the wicked cut off.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wait for the LORD and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

verses.rationale: Preserve rooted power image and violent character.
verses.before: I have seen a ruthless wicked person, spreading himself out like a flourishing native tree.
verses.after: I saw a wicked tyrant spreading like a flourishing tree in its native soil.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have seen a ruthless wicked person, spreading himself out like a flourishing native tree.

verses.rationale: Follow third-person passed and retain disappearance.
verses.before: Then he passed away, and look—he was no more; I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.after: Then he passed away—he was gone! I searched for him, but he could not be found.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he passed away, and look—he was no more; I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.rationale: Keep observation and open future or posterity sense.
verses.before: Observe the blameless and look upon the upright, for there is a future for the person of peace.
verses.after: Watch the blameless; look at the upright. There is a future for the person of peace.
verses.tsw_comparator: Observe the blameless and look upon the upright, for there is a future for the person of peace.

verses.rationale: Retain contrast using the same future term.
verses.before: But transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
verses.after: But rebels will be destroyed together; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
verses.tsw_comparator: But transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

verses.rationale: Keep salvation’s source and defensive image.
verses.before: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; he is their stronghold in a time of distress.
verses.after: The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD, their stronghold in times of distress.
verses.tsw_comparator: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; he is their stronghold in a time of distress.

verses.rationale: Preserve repeated rescue and closing refuge explanation.
verses.before: The LORD helps them and rescues them; he rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.
verses.after: The LORD helps and rescues them; he rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD helps them and rescues them; he rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.

verses.rationale: Retain uncertain liturgical title and parallel plea.
verses.before: LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger, do not discipline me in your wrath.
verses.after: A psalm of David. For remembrance. LORD, do not rebuke me in your rage or discipline me in your fury.
verses.tsw_comparator: LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger, do not discipline me in your wrath.

verses.rationale: Keep God explicitly addressed as afflicting agent.
verses.before: For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down upon me.
verses.after: Your arrows have sunk into me; your hand has come down upon me.
verses.tsw_comparator: For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down upon me.

verses.rationale: Preserve the speaker’s causal understanding and bodily distress.
verses.before: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.
verses.after: No part of my body is sound because of your indignation; there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.
verses.tsw_comparator: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.

verses.rationale: Retain drowning and burden images together.
verses.before: For my iniquities have risen over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
verses.after: My wrongdoings have risen over my head; like a heavy load, they are too much for me.
verses.tsw_comparator: For my iniquities have risen over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

verses.rationale: Keep disturbing physical detail and self-accusation.
verses.before: My wounds stink and fester because of my foolishness.
verses.after: My wounds stink and fester because of my folly.
verses.tsw_comparator: My wounds stink and fester because of my foolishness.

verses.rationale: Preserve posture and duration.
verses.before: I am bent and bowed down greatly; all day long I walk about in mourning.
verses.after: I am bent and bowed very low; all day I walk about mourning.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am bent and bowed down greatly; all day long I walk about in mourning.

verses.rationale: Choose burning reading and retain repeated bodily complaint.
verses.before: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.after: My loins are full of burning; no part of my body is sound.
verses.tsw_comparator: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.rationale: Keep forceful sound and inner agitation.
verses.before: I am numb and utterly crushed; I roar because of the groaning of my heart.
verses.after: I am numb and utterly crushed; I roar from the turmoil of my heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am numb and utterly crushed; I roar because of the groaning of my heart.

verses.rationale: Retain Adonai and unseen grief made known.
verses.before: Lord, all my longing is before you, and my groaning is not hidden from you.
verses.after: Lord, all my longing lies before you; my sighing is not hidden from you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Lord, all my longing is before you, and my groaning is not hidden from you.

verses.rationale: Preserve loss of vitality and sight image.
verses.before: My heart pounds; my strength has left me, and even the light of my eyes is gone from me.
verses.after: My heart pounds; my strength has left me. Even the light of my eyes is gone.
verses.tsw_comparator: My heart pounds; my strength has left me, and even the light of my eyes is gone from me.

verses.rationale: Keep relational abandonment without inferring contagion.
verses.before: My loved ones and my friends stand away from my affliction, and my close ones stand at a distance.
verses.after: My loved ones and friends stand back from my affliction; my relatives keep their distance.
verses.tsw_comparator: My loved ones and my friends stand away from my affliction, and my close ones stand at a distance.

verses.rationale: Retain lethal plotting and sustained speech.
verses.before: Those seeking my life lay snares, and those seeking my harm speak ruin; all day long they devise deceit.
verses.after: Those seeking my life set traps; those seeking my harm speak of ruin and devise deceit all day.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those seeking my life lay snares, and those seeking my harm speak ruin; all day long they devise deceit.

verses.rationale: Keep the comparisons as the speaker’s inability to respond.
verses.before: Yet I am like one deaf, who does not hear, like one mute, who does not open his mouth.
verses.after: But I am like someone deaf, unable to hear, like someone speechless, whose mouth does not open.
verses.tsw_comparator: But I am like one deaf, who does not hear, like one mute, who does not open his mouth.

verses.rationale: Retain silence and absence of rebuttal.
verses.before: I have become like one who does not hear, in whose mouth are no replies.
verses.after: I am like a person who hears nothing and has no argument to offer.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have become like one who does not hear, in whose mouth are no replies.

verses.rationale: Preserve waiting as reason for silence.
verses.before: For I wait for you, LORD; you will answer, Lord my God.
verses.after: For I wait for you, LORD; you will answer, Lord my God.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I wait for you, LORD; you will answer, Lord my God.

verses.rationale: Supply the implied negative request and keep stumbling image.
verses.before: For I said, “Let them not rejoice over me; when my foot slips, let them not exalt themselves over me.”
verses.after: I said, “Do not let them rejoice over me, exalting themselves when my foot slips.”
verses.tsw_comparator: For I said, “Let them not rejoice over me; when my foot slips, let them not exalt themselves over me.”

verses.rationale: Keep imminence and unrelieved suffering.
verses.before: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is always before me.
verses.after: I am close to falling; my pain is always before me.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is always before me.

verses.rationale: Retain open confession and emotional burden.
verses.before: For I confess my iniquity; I am troubled because of my sin.
verses.after: I confess my wrongdoing; my sin fills me with anxiety.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I confess my iniquity; I am troubled because of my sin.

verses.rationale: Follow pinned living/vigorous rather than replacing it with without cause.
verses.before: But my enemies are vigorous and strong, and many are people who hate me without cause.
verses.after: My enemies are vigorous and strong; those who hate me unjustly are many.
verses.tsw_comparator: But my enemies are vigorous and strong, and many are those who hate me without cause.

verses.rationale: Follow the read pursuit form and preserve moral tension with confession.
verses.before: People who repay evil for good accuse me because I pursue what is good.
verses.after: Those who repay good with evil oppose me because I pursue what is good.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those who repay evil for good accuse me because I pursue what is good.

verses.rationale: Keep repeated appeal for presence.
verses.before: Do not forsake me, LORD; my God, do not be far from me.
verses.after: Do not forsake me, LORD. My God, do not stay far away.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not forsake me, LORD; my God, do not be far from me.

verses.rationale: End with urgency and divine title.
verses.before: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
verses.after: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

verses.rationale: Retain personal name in title and deliberate restraint image.
verses.before: I said, “I will keep watch over my ways, so that I do not sin with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle over my mouth while the wicked are before me.”
verses.after: For the music leader. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. I said, “I will guard my ways so I do not sin with my tongue. I will muzzle my mouth while the wicked are before me.”
verses.tsw_comparator: I said, “I will keep watch over my ways, so that I do not sin with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle over my mouth while the wicked are before me.”

verses.rationale: Keep the cost of silence and ambiguous good phrase.
verses.before: I was mute in silence; I kept silent, even from good, and my pain was stirred up.
verses.after: I was silent, saying nothing, holding back even good words; but my pain grew worse.
verses.tsw_comparator: I was mute in silence; I kept silent, even from good, and my pain was stirred up.

verses.rationale: Preserve the mounting heat before speech.
verses.before: My heart grew hot within me; as I meditated, fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
verses.after: My heart grew hot within me; as I brooded, fire burned. Then my tongue spoke:
verses.tsw_comparator: My heart grew hot within me; as I meditated, fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:

verses.rationale: Keep mortality as the object of requested knowledge.
verses.before: “Make known to me, LORD, my end and the measure of my days—what it is; let me know how fleeting I am.
verses.after: “LORD, let me know my end and the measure of my days. Let me understand how fleeting I am.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Make known to me, LORD, my end and the measure of my days—what it is; let me know how fleeting I am.

verses.rationale: Retain concrete measure and apparent stability overturned.
verses.before: Look, you have made my days handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every human being, standing firm, is only breath. Selah
verses.after: You have made my days a few handbreadths; my lifetime is nothing before you. Surely every person, even standing firm, is only a breath. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look, you have made my days handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every human being, standing firm, is only breath. Selah

verses.rationale: Keep shadow, breath, and uncertain inheritor.
verses.before: Surely a person walks about as an image; surely they bustle about for breath. One heaps up, but does not know who will gather it.
verses.after: People walk about as mere shadows; their bustle is only a breath. They heap things up without knowing who will gather them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Surely a person walks about as an image; surely they bustle about for breath. One heaps up, but does not know who will gather it.

verses.rationale: Retain the question and direct answer.
verses.before: And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope—it is in you.
verses.after: And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
verses.tsw_comparator: And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope—it is in you.

verses.rationale: Keep personal guilt and social disgrace.
verses.before: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of a fool.
verses.after: Rescue me from all my rebellions; do not make me a fool’s laughingstock.
verses.tsw_comparator: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of a fool.

verses.rationale: Preserve God’s agency and renewed silence.
verses.before: I am mute; I do not open my mouth, for you have done it.
verses.after: I am silent; I do not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am mute; I do not open my mouth, for you have done it.

verses.rationale: Retain the painful appeal against divine attack.
verses.before: Remove your blow from me; I am spent by the assault of your hand.
verses.after: Remove your blow from me; I am spent by the assault of your hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: Remove your blow from me; I am spent by the assault of your hand.

verses.rationale: Keep moral discipline, moth, and repeated frailty refrain.
verses.before: With rebukes for iniquity you discipline a person, and like a moth you melt away what is precious to them. Surely every human being is breath. Selah
verses.after: When you discipline someone with rebukes for wrongdoing, you consume what they cherish like a moth. Surely every person is only a breath. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: With rebukes for iniquity you discipline a person, and like a moth you melt away what is precious to them. Surely every human being is breath. Selah

verses.rationale: Retain vulnerable residency before God and ancestral connection.
verses.before: Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry; do not be silent at my tears. For I am a sojourner with you, a resident alien, like all my ancestors.
verses.after: Hear my prayer, LORD; listen to my cry for help. Do not be silent at my tears. I am a resident alien with you, a temporary settler like all my ancestors.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry; do not be silent at my tears. For I am a sojourner with you, a resident alien, like all my ancestors.

verses.rationale: Keep the unsettling request for divine withdrawal and unresolved ending.
verses.before: Look away from me, that I may brighten, before I go and am no more.”
verses.after: Look away from me, so I may brighten again before I go and am no more.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Look away from me, that I may brighten, before I go and am no more.”

verses.rationale: Render emphatic waiting through repetition.
verses.before: I waited and waited for the LORD, and the LORD leaned toward me and heard my cry.
verses.after: For the music leader. Of David. A psalm. I waited and waited for the LORD; he bent toward me and heard my cry.
verses.tsw_comparator: I waited and waited for the LORD, and the LORD leaned toward me and heard my cry.

verses.rationale: Keep roaring and mud images with stable footing.
verses.before: The LORD brought me up from the pit of roaring, out of the mud and mire, and set my feet on a rock, making my steps secure.
verses.after: He brought me up from a roaring pit, from clinging mud. He set my feet on a rock and made my steps secure.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD brought me up from the pit of roaring, out of the mud and mire, and set my feet on a rock, making my steps secure.

verses.rationale: Retain the linked responses and shift to our God.
verses.before: The LORD put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and will trust in the LORD.
verses.after: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and trust in the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and will trust in the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep trust as allegiance and two rejected alternatives.
verses.before: Happy is the one who makes the LORD their trust, who does not turn to the proud, nor to people who swerve into falsehood.
verses.after: Happy is the one who makes the LORD their trust, who does not turn to the arrogant or those straying after lies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Happy is the one who makes the LORD their trust, who does not turn to the proud, nor to those who swerve into falsehood.

verses.rationale: Retain both thoughts toward us and no comparison to you; separate clauses avoid making thoughts the sole object of comparison.
verses.before: Many things you have done, O LORD my God— your wonders and your purposes for us; none can compare with you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
verses.after: LORD my God, you have done so many wonders; your thoughts are for us. No one compares with you. If I tried to tell and recount them, they would be too many to number.
verses.tsw_comparator: Many things you have done, O LORD my God— your wonders and your purposes for us; none can compare with you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

verses.rationale: Preserve pinned ears image rather than replacing it with body.
verses.before: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but you opened my ears. Burnt offering and sin offering you did not require.
verses.after: You did not desire sacrifice and offering; you dug out ears for me. You did not ask for burnt offering or sin offering.
verses.tsw_comparator: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but you opened my ears. Burnt offering and sin offering you did not require.

verses.rationale: Keep the scroll’s relation to speaker open to a note.
verses.before: Then I said, “Look—I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written of me.
verses.after: Then I said, “Here I am; I have come. In the scroll it is written about me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I said, “Look—I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written of me.

verses.rationale: Retain delight and embodied inward teaching.
verses.before: I delight to do your will, O my God; your instruction is within my heart.”
verses.after: I delight to do your will, my God; your instruction is deep within me.”
verses.tsw_comparator: I delight to do your will, O my God; your instruction is within my heart.”

verses.rationale: Keep public proclamation and divine witness.
verses.before: I have proclaimed good news of righteousness in the great assembly; look—I have not restrained my lips, O LORD, you know.
verses.after: I have announced righteousness in the great assembly. I have not held my lips back, LORD; you know.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have proclaimed good news of righteousness in the great assembly; look—I have not restrained my lips, O LORD, you know.

verses.rationale: Preserve repeated refusal to conceal and distinct covenant vocabulary.
verses.before: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart; I have spoken of your faithfulness and your saving help. I have not concealed your steadfast love and your truth from the great assembly.
verses.after: I have not hidden your righteousness in my heart. I have told of your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed your faithful love and truth from the great assembly.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart; I have spoken of your faithfulness and your saving help. I have not concealed your steadfast love and your truth from the great assembly.

verses.rationale: Keep correspondence between unrestrained praise and compassion.
verses.before: As for you, O LORD, do not withhold your compassion from me; let your steadfast love and your truth continually keep me.
verses.after: You, LORD, will not hold your compassion back from me; your faithful love and truth will always guard me.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for you, O LORD, do not withhold your compassion from me; let your steadfast love and your truth continually keep me.

verses.rationale: Retain guilt, blindness, and overwhelming number.
verses.before: For troubles have surrounded me beyond number; my iniquities have overtaken me, so that I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.
verses.after: Troubles beyond counting surround me. My wrongdoings have caught up with me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs on my head; my heart has failed me.
verses.tsw_comparator: For troubles have surrounded me beyond number; my iniquities have overtaken me, so that I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.

verses.rationale: Keep doubled divine address and urgent appeal.
verses.before: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, hurry to help me!
verses.after: Be pleased to rescue me, LORD; LORD, hurry to help me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, hurry to help me!

verses.rationale: Preserve distinct lethal intent and pleasure in harm.
verses.before: Let those be put to shame and confounded together who seek my life to destroy it. Let those be turned back and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
verses.after: Let those seeking to destroy my life be ashamed and humiliated together. Let those who delight in my harm retreat in disgrace.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let those be put to shame and confounded together who seek my life to destroy it. Let those be turned back and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

verses.rationale: Keep taunt and reversal.
verses.before: Let those be appalled because of their shame who say to me, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.after: Let those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let those be appalled because of their shame who say to me, “Aha! Aha!”

verses.rationale: Retain communal joy and recurring praise.
verses.before: But let everyone who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; let people who love your salvation say continually, “The LORD is great!”
verses.after: Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation always say, “Great is the LORD!”
verses.tsw_comparator: But let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; let those who love your salvation say continually, “The LORD is great!”

verses.rationale: Keep vulnerability alongside past rescue, ending in urgency.
verses.before: Yet I am poor and needy; yet the Lord takes thought for me. You are my help and my deliverer; O my God, do not delay!
verses.after: But I am afflicted and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my rescuer. My God, do not delay.
verses.tsw_comparator: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord takes thought for me. You are my help and my deliverer; O my God, do not delay!

verses.rationale: Preserve thoughtful care and reciprocal protection.
verses.before: Blessed is the one who pays attention to the weak; in the day of trouble the LORD will deliver them.
verses.after: For the music leader. A psalm of David. Happy is the one who attends to the weak; the LORD will rescue that person on a day of trouble.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed is the one who pays attention to the weak; in the day of trouble the LORD will deliver them.

verses.rationale: Follow read blessed form and preserve shift into prayer.
verses.before: The LORD will guard them and preserve their life; they will be called blessed in the land. You will not give them over to the desire of their enemies.
verses.after: The LORD will guard them and keep them alive; they will be called happy in the land. Do not hand them over to their enemies’ desires.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD will guard them and preserve their life; they will be called blessed in the land. You will not give them over to the desire of their enemies.

verses.rationale: Retain the difficult bed-turning image and person shift for a note.
verses.before: The LORD sustains them on the bed of illness; you turn their whole bed in their sickness.
verses.after: The LORD will sustain them on their sickbed; you will turn their whole bed in their illness.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD sustains them on the bed of illness; you turn their whole bed in their sickness.

verses.rationale: Keep the speaker’s confession within the illness prayer.
verses.before: As for me, I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against you.”
verses.after: I said, “LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
verses.tsw_comparator: As for me, I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against you.”

verses.rationale: Retain hostile desire for death and forgotten identity.
verses.before: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die and his name perish?”
verses.after: My enemies say maliciously, “When will he die and his name disappear?”
verses.tsw_comparator: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die and his name perish?”

verses.rationale: Clarify sickroom visitor’s duplicity without inventing an identity.
verses.before: If someone comes to see me, they speak emptiness; their heart gathers trouble. When they go outside, they tell it.
verses.after: A visitor comes and speaks empty words, gathering harmful gossip in his heart; then he goes outside and spreads it.
verses.tsw_comparator: If someone comes to see me, they speak emptiness; their heart gathers trouble. When they go outside, they tell it.

verses.rationale: Keep collective whispering and open its content.
verses.before: Everyone who hate me whisper together against me; against me they devise harm:
verses.after: All who hate me whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me:
verses.tsw_comparator: All who hate me whisper together against me; against me they devise harm:

verses.rationale: Retain ambiguous destructive thing rather than naming a disease.
verses.before: “A deadly thing has been poured upon him; now that he lies down, he will not rise again.”
verses.after: “A deadly thing has fastened on him; now that he lies down, he will never rise again.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “A deadly thing has been poured upon him; now that he lies down, he will not rise again.”

verses.rationale: Preserve shared food and the betrayal image.
verses.before: Even my close friend, in whom I trusted, the one who ate my bread, has lifted the heel against me.
verses.after: Even my close friend, whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has raised his heel against me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Even my close friend, in whom I trusted, the one who ate my bread, has lifted the heel against me.

verses.rationale: Keep retributive purpose rather than softening it to recovery alone.
verses.before: But you, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, so that I may repay them.
verses.after: But you, LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, so I can repay them.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, so that I may repay them.

verses.rationale: Retain the speaker’s sign of favor.
verses.before: By this I know that you delight in me: my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.
verses.after: By this I know you delight in me: my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.
verses.tsw_comparator: By this I know that you delight in me: my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.

verses.rationale: Keep integrity and enduring presence.
verses.before: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity; you set me before your face forever.
verses.after: You uphold me in my integrity and set me in your presence forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity; you set me before your face forever.

verses.rationale: Retain the closing doxology and repeated amen.
verses.before: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
verses.after: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

verses.rationale: Bind title and thirsty creature image without modernizing it.
verses.before: As a deer longs for channels of water, so my soul longs for you, O God.
verses.after: For the music leader. A maskil of the sons of Korah. As a deer longs for streams of water, so I long for you, God.
verses.tsw_comparator: As a deer longs for channels of water, so my soul longs for you, O God.

verses.rationale: Follow pointed appear rather than silently changing to see.
verses.before: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When will I come and appear before the face of God?
verses.after: I thirst for God, for the living God. When may I come and appear before God’s face?
verses.tsw_comparator: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before the face of God?

verses.rationale: Keep unceasing grief and hostile question.
verses.before: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say to me all day, “Where is your God?”
verses.after: My tears have been my food day and night, while people keep asking me, “Where is your God?”
verses.tsw_comparator: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say to me all day, “Where is your God?”

verses.rationale: Choose procession reading and preserve remembered communal worship.
verses.before: These things I remember as I pour out my soul within me: how I passed with the throng, leading them in procession to the house of God, with the sound of rejoicing and thanksgiving, a multitude keeping festival.
verses.after: I remember these things and pour out my life within me: how I went with the crowd, leading them to God’s house, with joyful cries and thanksgiving, a multitude keeping festival.
verses.tsw_comparator: These things I remember as I pour out my soul within me: how I passed with the throng, leading them in procession to the house of God, with the sound of rejoicing and thanksgiving, a multitude keeping festival.

verses.rationale: Preserve pinned his face and distinguish this refrain from the later form.
verses.before: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I will again praise God, the saving help of God’s face.
verses.after: Why are you bowed down, my soul? Why do you roar within me? Hope in God, for I will yet thank him for the saving help of his presence.
verses.tsw_comparator: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I shall again praise God, the saving help of God’s face.

verses.rationale: Keep divine address here and all three geographical expressions.
verses.before: My God, my soul is bowed down within me; so I remember you from the land of Jordan and Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
verses.after: My God, my soul is bowed down within me. So I remember you from the land of the Jordan, from the heights of Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
verses.tsw_comparator: My God, my soul is bowed down within me; therefore I remember you from the land of Jordan and Hermon, from Mount Mizar.

verses.rationale: Retain overwhelming waters explicitly called God’s.
verses.before: Deep calls to deep at the sound of your waterfalls; all your breakers and your waves have passed over me.
verses.after: Deep calls to deep at the roar of your waterfalls; all your breakers and waves have swept over me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Deep calls to deep at the sound of your waterfalls; all your breakers and your waves have passed over me.

verses.rationale: Follow read his song and preserve day/night movement.
verses.before: By day the LORD commands steadfast love, and at night the LORD’s song is with me— a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.after: By day the LORD commands his faithful love; by night his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.tsw_comparator: By day the LORD commands steadfast love, and at night the LORD’s song is with me— a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.rationale: Keep trust title alongside accusation of abandonment.
verses.before: I say to God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning under the oppression of the enemy?”
verses.after: I say to God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning under the enemy’s oppression?”
verses.tsw_comparator: I say to God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning under the oppression of the enemy?”

verses.rationale: Retain bodily force and repeated taunt.
verses.before: As with a crushing in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they say to me all day, “Where is your God?”
verses.after: Like a deadly blow to my bones, my foes taunt me, asking all day long, “Where is your God?”
verses.tsw_comparator: As with a crushing in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they say to me all day, “Where is your God?”

verses.rationale: Repeat the shared refrain exactly; render salvation of my face as my saving help, explaining the bodily image in a note.
verses.before: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I will again praise God, the saving help of my face and my God.
verses.after: Why are you bowed down, my soul? Why do you roar within me? Hope in God, for I will yet thank him, my saving help, my God.
verses.tsw_comparator: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I shall again praise God, the saving help of my face and my God.

verses.rationale: Preserve legal appeal and collective hostility.
verses.before: Vindicate me, O God, and contend my case against an unfaithful nation; from a deceitful and unjust person rescue me.
verses.after: Vindicate me, God; defend my cause against a faithless nation. Rescue me from deceitful and unjust people.
verses.tsw_comparator: Vindicate me, O God, and contend my case against an unfaithful nation; from a deceitful and unjust person rescue me.

verses.rationale: Keep refuge and rejection together with the earlier question.
verses.before: For you are God, my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning under the oppression of the enemy?
verses.after: You are the God of my refuge. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning under the enemy’s oppression?
verses.tsw_comparator: For you are God, my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning under the oppression of the enemy?

verses.rationale: Retain personified guides and sanctuary destination.
verses.before: Send out your light and your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy mountain and to your dwelling places.
verses.after: Send your light and your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy mountain, to your dwelling places.
verses.tsw_comparator: Send out your light and your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy mountain and to your dwelling places.

verses.rationale: Keep altar, music, and doubled personal address.
verses.before: Then I will come to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy; and I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.
verses.after: Then I will come to God’s altar, to God, my overflowing joy. I will thank you with the lyre, God, my God.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then I will come to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy; and I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.

verses.rationale: Repeat the shared refrain exactly; render salvation of my face as my saving help, explaining the bodily image in a note.
verses.before: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I will again praise God, the saving help of my face and my God.
verses.after: Why are you bowed down, my soul? Why do you roar within me? Hope in God, for I will yet thank him, my saving help, my God.
verses.tsw_comparator: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God, for I shall again praise God, the saving help of my face and my God.

verses.rationale: Preserve title and transmitted communal memory.
verses.before: O God, with our ears we have heard; our ancestors have told us the work you worked in their days, in days of old.
verses.after: For the music leader. Of the sons of Korah. A maskil. God, we have heard with our own ears; our ancestors told us what you did in their days, long ago.
verses.tsw_comparator: O God, with our ears we have heard; our ancestors have told us the work you worked in their days, in days of old.

verses.rationale: Clarify changing objects of the parallel verbs while retaining displacement.
verses.before: With your hand you drove out nations, but you planted our people; you afflicted peoples, but you spread our people out.
verses.after: With your hand you drove out nations and planted our ancestors. You afflicted peoples and spread our ancestors abroad.
verses.tsw_comparator: With your hand you drove out nations, but you planted our people; you afflicted peoples, but you spread our people out.

verses.rationale: Retain denial of human power and bodily divine images.
verses.before: For not by their sword did they possess the land, and their arm did not save them; but your right hand and your arm, and the light of your face, because you delighted in them.
verses.after: They did not gain the land by their own sword; their own arm did not save them. It was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you favored them.
verses.tsw_comparator: For not by their sword did they possess the land, and their arm did not save them; but your right hand and your arm, and the light of your face, because you delighted in them.

verses.rationale: Keep singular voice within communal prayer.
verses.before: You are my King, O God; command saving help for Jacob.
verses.after: You are my king, God; command victories for Jacob.
verses.tsw_comparator: You are my King, O God; command saving help for Jacob.

verses.rationale: Preserve aggressive victory images.
verses.before: Through you we push back our foes; through your name we tread down people who rise against us.
verses.after: Through you we thrust back our foes; through your name we trample those who rise against us.
verses.tsw_comparator: Through you we push back our foes; through your name we tread down those who rise against us.

verses.rationale: Keep first-person military disavowal.
verses.before: For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword does not save me.
verses.after: I do not trust in my bow; my sword cannot save me.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword does not save me.

verses.rationale: Retain remembered collective rescue.
verses.before: But you have saved us from our foes and put to shame people who hate us.
verses.after: You saved us from our foes and put those who hate us to shame.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you have saved us from our foes and put to shame those who hate us.

verses.rationale: Keep shift to direct address and enduring praise.
verses.before: In God we boast all day long, and we praise your name forever. Selah.
verses.after: In God we boast all day long; we will thank your name forever. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: In God we boast all day long, and we praise your name forever. Selah.

verses.rationale: Preserve abrupt contradiction of prior confidence.
verses.before: Yet you have rejected us and put us to shame, and you do not go out with our armies.
verses.after: Yet you have rejected and disgraced us; you no longer march out with our armies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet you have rejected us and put us to shame, and you do not go out with our armies.

verses.rationale: Keep God’s agency in defeat and enemy gain.
verses.before: You make us turn back from the foe, and people who hate us plunder for themselves.
verses.after: You make us retreat before the foe; those who hate us plunder us for themselves.
verses.tsw_comparator: You make us turn back from the foe, and those who hate us plunder for themselves.

verses.rationale: Retain slaughter and dispersion images.
verses.before: You give us like sheep for food, and you scatter us among the nations.
verses.after: You hand us over like sheep for food and scatter us among the nations.
verses.tsw_comparator: You give us like sheep for food, and you scatter us among the nations.

verses.rationale: Preserve protest at a sale without benefit.
verses.before: You sell your people for no gain; you gain nothing from their price.
verses.after: You sell your people for nothing and gain no wealth from their price.
verses.tsw_comparator: You sell your people for no gain; you gain nothing from their price.

verses.rationale: Keep God directly accused of public humiliation.
verses.before: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
verses.after: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and a jeer to those around us.
verses.tsw_comparator: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.

verses.rationale: Clarify gesture of derision and international setting.
verses.before: You make us a proverb among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.after: You make us a byword among the nations, a people at whom others shake their heads.
verses.tsw_comparator: You make us a proverb among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

verses.rationale: Preserve shift into singular lament and continue its cause.
verses.before: All day my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face covers me,
verses.after: My disgrace is before me all day; shame covers my face,
verses.tsw_comparator: All day my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face covers me,

verses.rationale: Retain both spoken and confronting hostility.
verses.before: at the voice of the one who taunts and reviles, before the enemy and the avenger.
verses.after: at the voice of the one who taunts and reviles, at the sight of the enemy bent on revenge.
verses.tsw_comparator: at the voice of the one who taunts and reviles, before the enemy and the avenger.

verses.rationale: Keep the community’s claim of undeserved suffering.
verses.before: All this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you, and we have not dealt falsely with your covenant.
verses.after: All this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you or been false to your covenant.
verses.tsw_comparator: All this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you, and we have not dealt falsely with your covenant.

verses.rationale: Retain negation over both parallel clauses.
verses.before: Our heart has not turned back, and our steps have not departed from your path,
verses.after: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from your path,
verses.tsw_comparator: Our heart has not turned back, and our steps have not departed from your path,

verses.rationale: Preserve God’s agency and desolate animal habitat.
verses.before: though you crushed us in a place of jackals and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.after: though you crushed us in a place of jackals and covered us with deepest darkness.
verses.tsw_comparator: though you crushed us in a place of jackals and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.rationale: Keep hypothetical disloyal worship and its gesture.
verses.before: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.after: If we had forgotten our God’s name or spread our hands to a foreign god,
verses.tsw_comparator: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

verses.rationale: Retain rhetorical appeal to divine knowledge as support for innocence.
verses.before: would not God discover this? For God knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.after: would not God search this out? He knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: would not God discover this? For God knows the secrets of the heart.

verses.rationale: Keep suffering for God without harmonizing to later quotation.
verses.before: Yet for your sake we are killed all day long; we are counted as sheep for slaughter.
verses.after: Yet because of you we are killed all day long, counted as sheep for slaughter.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet for your sake we are killed all day long; we are counted as sheep for slaughter.

verses.rationale: Preserve provocative divine-sleep language.
verses.before: Awake! Why do you sleep, Lord? Rouse yourself; do not reject us forever.
verses.after: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Rise! Do not reject us forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: Awake! Why do you sleep, Lord? Rouse yourself; do not reject us forever.

verses.rationale: Retain unsoftened question about absence.
verses.before: Why do you hide your face? Why do you forget our affliction and oppression?
verses.after: Why do you hide your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
verses.tsw_comparator: Why do you hide your face? Why do you forget our affliction and oppression?

verses.rationale: Keep bodily prostration and abasement.
verses.before: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly clings to the earth.
verses.after: We have sunk down into the dust; our bellies cling to the ground.
verses.tsw_comparator: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly clings to the earth.

verses.rationale: End with relational appeal rather than invented resolution.
verses.before: Rise up; be our help. Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love.
verses.after: Rise to help us; redeem us for the sake of your faithful love.
verses.tsw_comparator: Rise up; be our help. Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love.

verses.rationale: Include each title element and preserve poet/scribe imagery.
verses.before: My heart overflows with a good word; I address my song to the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful scribe.
verses.after: For the music leader. According to “Lilies.” Of the sons of Korah. A maskil. A song of love. My heart overflows with a good word; I address my verses to the king. My tongue is a skilled scribe’s pen.
verses.tsw_comparator: My heart overflows with a good word; I address my song to the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful scribe.

verses.rationale: Retain explicit male beauty because the source names it.
verses.before: You are the most beautiful of mortals; grace is poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
verses.after: You are the most handsome of men; grace pours from your lips. That is why God has blessed you forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: You are the most beautiful of mortals; grace is poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.

verses.rationale: Keep royal military dress and address.
verses.before: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and majesty.
verses.after: Strap your sword to your thigh, mighty warrior, in your splendor and majesty.
verses.tsw_comparator: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and majesty.

verses.rationale: Preserve difficult linked virtues and instructing hand.
verses.before: In your majesty, ride on victoriously for the sake of truth and humility and righteousness; let your right hand teach you awesome deeds.
verses.after: In your majesty ride on to victory for truth, humility, and righteousness; let your right hand teach you awesome deeds.
verses.tsw_comparator: In your majesty, ride on victoriously for the sake of truth and humility and righteousness; let your right hand teach you awesome deeds.

verses.rationale: Make the compressed arrow action clear without removing violence.
verses.before: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; peoples fall under you.
verses.after: Your arrows are sharp; peoples fall beneath you— they strike the hearts of the king’s enemies.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; peoples fall under you.

verses.rationale: Preserve consequential divine address and document alternative syntax.
verses.before: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; the scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of equity.
verses.after: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; the scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of fairness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; the scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of equity.

verses.rationale: Keep God/your God distinction and anointing comparison.
verses.before: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy beyond your companions.
verses.after: You love righteousness and hate wickedness. So God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy above your companions.
verses.tsw_comparator: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy beyond your companions.

verses.rationale: Supply scent naturally and note uncertain musical term.
verses.before: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from ivory palaces stringed instruments make you glad.
verses.after: All your garments smell of myrrh, aloes, and cassia; from ivory palaces string music brings you joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from ivory palaces stringed instruments make you glad.

verses.rationale: Retain women’s distinct royal roles and prized gold.
verses.before: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.after: Kings’ daughters are among your honored women; at your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.
verses.tsw_comparator: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.rationale: Preserve the shift to the bride and the demanding instruction.
verses.before: Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear: forget your people and your father’s house,
verses.after: Listen, daughter; look and bend your ear. Forget your people and your father’s house.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear: forget your people and your father’s house,

verses.rationale: Keep hierarchy and physical beauty without modernizing the marriage.
verses.before: and the king will desire your beauty. Since he is your lord, bow down to him.
verses.after: Let the king desire your beauty; he is your lord, so bow before him.
verses.tsw_comparator: and the king will desire your beauty. Since he is your lord, bow down to him.

verses.rationale: Retain city personification and gifts seeking goodwill.
verses.before: The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; the rich among the people will seek your favor.
verses.after: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift; the richest of the people seek your favor.
verses.tsw_comparator: The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; the rich among the people will seek your favor.

verses.rationale: Read inward location spatially rather than as moral inner beauty.
verses.before: All glorious is the princess within; her clothing is interwoven with gold.
verses.after: The king’s daughter is all splendor within her chamber; her clothing is woven with gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: All glorious is the princess within; her clothing is interwoven with gold.

verses.rationale: Retain female attendants and return to male addressee.
verses.before: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; the young women, her companions, follow her— they are brought to you.
verses.after: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; virgin companions follow her and are brought to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; the young women, her companions, follow her— they are brought to you.

verses.rationale: Preserve plural procession and destination.
verses.before: With joy and gladness they are led along as they enter the palace of the king.
verses.after: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the king’s palace.
verses.tsw_comparator: With joy and gladness they are led along as they enter the palace of the king.

verses.rationale: Keep masculine address and dynastic succession.
verses.before: In place of your fathers will be your sons; you will make them princes in all the earth.
verses.after: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will appoint them princes throughout the land.
verses.tsw_comparator: In place of your fathers will be your sons; you will make them princes in all the earth.

verses.rationale: Retain poet’s promise to the king and international praise.
verses.before: I will cause your name to be remembered in all generations; therefore the peoples will praise you forever and ever.
verses.after: I will make your name remembered in every generation; so peoples will praise you forever and ever.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will cause your name to be remembered in all generations; therefore the peoples will praise you forever and ever.

verses.rationale: Keep title and accessibility of help.
verses.before: God is our refuge and strength, a help in troubles, very near at hand.
verses.after: For the music leader. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, a help readily found in distress.
verses.tsw_comparator: God is our refuge and strength, a help in troubles, very near at hand.

verses.rationale: Preserve cosmic instability and continue the sentence.
verses.before: So we will not fear though the earth gives way, though the mountains topple into the heart of the seas;
verses.after: So we will not fear though the earth changes and mountains slip into the heart of the seas,
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore we will not fear though the earth gives way, though the mountains topple into the heart of the seas;

verses.rationale: Retain waters’ force and shaking terrain.
verses.before: though its waters roar and foam, though the mountains tremble at its surging. *Selah*
verses.after: though their waters roar and foam and mountains shake at their swelling. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: though its waters roar and foam, though the mountains tremble at its surging. *Selah*

verses.rationale: Keep singular river with multiple streams and sacred city.
verses.before: There is a river whose streams gladden the city of God, the holy dwelling of the Most High.
verses.after: A river’s streams gladden God’s city, the holy dwelling place of the Most High.
verses.tsw_comparator: There is a river whose streams gladden the city of God, the holy dwelling of the Most High.

verses.rationale: Retain feminine city personification and dawn rescue.
verses.before: God is in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her at the break of morning.
verses.after: God is within her; she will not fall. God will help her when morning dawns.
verses.tsw_comparator: God is in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her at the break of morning.

verses.rationale: Keep nation/water parallel and divine voice.
verses.before: The nations were in uproar, the kingdoms tottered; he lifted his voice—the earth melts.
verses.after: Nations roar, kingdoms fall; he raises his voice, and the earth melts.
verses.tsw_comparator: The nations were in uproar, the kingdoms tottered; he lifted his voice—the earth melts.

verses.rationale: Establish the refrain exactly for repetition.
verses.before: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. *Selah*
verses.after: The LORD of Armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. *Selah*

verses.rationale: Retain destruction rather than replacing it with generic wonders.
verses.before: Come, look the works of the LORD, who has set desolations on the earth—
verses.after: Come and see the LORD’s works, the desolations he has brought upon the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: Come, behold the works of the LORD, who has set desolations on the earth—

verses.rationale: Follow pinned wagons and keep military disarmament.
verses.before: making wars cease to the end of the earth, breaking the bow and shattering the spear, burning the chariots with fire.
verses.after: He stops wars to the ends of the earth. He breaks the bow, cuts the spear apart, and burns the wagons with fire.
verses.tsw_comparator: making wars cease to the end of the earth, breaking the bow and shattering the spear, burning the chariots with fire.

verses.rationale: Render cease/release in the conflict context and mark divine speech.
verses.before: “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”
verses.after: “Let go, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted throughout the earth.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”

verses.rationale: Repeat the refrain without unnecessary synonym changes.
verses.before: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. *Selah*
verses.after: The LORD of Armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. *Selah*

verses.rationale: Retain title and universal summons.
verses.before: Clap your hands, all peoples; shout to God with a voice of joy.
verses.after: For the music leader. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. Clap your hands, all peoples; shout to God with joyful cries!
verses.tsw_comparator: Clap your hands, all peoples; shout to God with a voice of joy.

verses.rationale: Keep divine title and worldwide kingship.
verses.before: For the LORD Most High is fearsome, a great king over all the earth.
verses.after: The LORD Most High is awe-inspiring, a great king over all the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD Most High is fearsome, a great king over all the earth.

verses.rationale: Retain subjugation in the communal celebration.
verses.before: He subdued peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
verses.after: He subdues peoples beneath us, nations beneath our feet.
verses.tsw_comparator: He subdued peoples under us, and nations under our feet.

verses.rationale: Keep inheritance and loved Jacob without assigning a narrower referent.
verses.before: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom he loves.
verses.after: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loves. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom he loves.

verses.rationale: Retain ascent and instrument without inventing a ceremony’s details.
verses.before: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.after: God goes up amid shouts, the LORD amid the sound of the ram’s horn.
verses.tsw_comparator: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.rationale: Keep all four calls and their emphatic repetition.
verses.before: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our king, sing praises.
verses.after: Sing praise to God, sing praise! Sing praise to our king, sing praise!
verses.tsw_comparator: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our king, sing praises.

verses.rationale: Render maskil’s wisdom association while noting uncertainty.
verses.before: For God is king of all the earth; sing praises with understanding.
verses.after: God is king of all the earth; sing a song of understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: For God is king of all the earth; sing praises with understanding.

verses.rationale: Keep repeated God and royal imagery.
verses.before: God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.
verses.after: God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.
verses.tsw_comparator: God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.

verses.rationale: Keep difficult gathering relation and shields metaphor.
verses.before: The princes of the peoples gather as the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God; he is highly exalted.
verses.after: The nobles of the peoples gather as the people of Abraham’s God. The shields of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.
verses.tsw_comparator: The princes of the peoples gather as the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God; he is highly exalted.

verses.rationale: Preserve title and location of praise.
verses.before: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, on the holy mountain.
verses.after: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised in our God’s city, his holy mountain.
verses.tsw_comparator: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, on the holy mountain.

verses.rationale: Retain north/Zaphon expression for explanatory note rather than correcting geography.
verses.before: Beautiful in height, the joy of all the earth, is Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great King.
verses.after: Beautiful in height, the joy of all the earth, is Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great king.
verses.tsw_comparator: Beautiful in height, the joy of all the earth, is Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great King.

verses.rationale: Keep city’s feminine reference and divine defense.
verses.before: God is in her citadels; God has revealed a stronghold.
verses.after: Within her citadels, God has made himself known as a stronghold.
verses.tsw_comparator: God is in her citadels; God has made known a stronghold.

verses.rationale: Preserve alliance and movement toward the city.
verses.before: For look, the kings assembled; they passed by together.
verses.after: Look, the kings assembled; together they advanced.
verses.tsw_comparator: For look, the kings assembled; they passed by together.

verses.rationale: Keep rapid sequence of defeat without inventing battle details.
verses.before: They saw it and were astonished; they panicked; they fled.
verses.after: They saw and were astonished; terrified, they fled in haste.
verses.tsw_comparator: They saw it and were astonished; they panicked; they fled.

verses.rationale: Retain gender-specific birth comparison.
verses.before: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
verses.after: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
verses.tsw_comparator: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.

verses.rationale: Keep sudden direct address and maritime comparison.
verses.before: With an east wind you shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.after: With an east wind you shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.tsw_comparator: With an east wind you shatter the ships of Tarshish.

verses.rationale: Preserve received tradition confirmed by sight.
verses.before: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish her forever. Selah.
verses.after: As we heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Armies, in our God’s city. God will establish her forever. Selah.
verses.tsw_comparator: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish her forever. Selah.

verses.rationale: Keep communal reflection and location.
verses.before: We have pondered your steadfast love, O God, within your temple.
verses.after: We ponder your faithful love, God, within your temple.
verses.tsw_comparator: We have pondered your steadfast love, O God, within your temple.

verses.rationale: Retain global reach and ethical hand image.
verses.before: As your name, O God, so your praise reaches to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is filled with righteousness.
verses.after: Like your name, God, your praise reaches the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.tsw_comparator: As your name, O God, so your praise reaches to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is filled with righteousness.

verses.rationale: Keep daughters metaphor with towns as note possibility.
verses.before: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let the daughters of Judah be glad because of your judgments.
verses.after: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let the daughters of Judah be glad because of your judgments.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let the daughters of Judah be glad because of your judgments.

verses.rationale: Preserve invitation to inspect concrete defenses.
verses.before: Walk around Zion; go all around her; count her towers.
verses.after: Walk around Zion; make a circuit. Count her towers.
verses.tsw_comparator: Walk around Zion; go all around her; count her towers.

verses.rationale: Keep observation serving intergenerational transmission.
verses.before: Set your hearts on her ramparts; pass through her citadels, so that you may tell the next generation:
verses.after: Take her rampart to heart; examine her citadels, so you can tell the next generation:
verses.tsw_comparator: Set your hearts on her ramparts; pass through her citadels, so that you may tell the next generation:

verses.rationale: Retain difficult final death phrase and document other readings.
verses.before: This is God, our God forever and ever; God will guide us until death.
verses.after: “This is God, our God forever and ever. He will guide us unto death.”
verses.tsw_comparator: This is God, our God forever and ever; God will guide us until death.

verses.rationale: Preserve title and universal wisdom audience.
verses.before: Hear this, all peoples; give ear, everyone who dwell in the world,
verses.after: For the music leader. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. Hear this, all peoples; listen, everyone who lives in the world,
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear this, all peoples; give ear, all who dwell in the world,

verses.rationale: Render paired human designations socially and inclusively.
verses.before: both low and high, rich and poor together.
verses.after: people of low and high standing, rich and needy together.
verses.tsw_comparator: both low and high, rich and poor together.

verses.rationale: Keep outward speech and inward thought.
verses.before: My mouth will speak wisdom; the meditation of my heart will be understanding.
verses.after: My mouth will speak wisdom; my heart’s meditation will bring understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: My mouth will speak wisdom; the meditation of my heart will be understanding.

verses.rationale: Retain teacher also listening and musical explanation.
verses.before: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open my riddle with the lyre.
verses.after: I will bend my ear to a proverb; with a lyre I will unfold my riddle.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open my riddle with the lyre.

verses.rationale: Keep threatening heels idiom and continue the referent.
verses.before: Why should I fear in days of evil, when the iniquity of those at my heels surrounds me,
verses.after: Why should I fear in evil days, when the wrongdoing of those at my heels surrounds me—
verses.tsw_comparator: Why should I fear in days of evil, when the iniquity of those at my heels surrounds me,

verses.rationale: Identify the threatening wealthy without generalizing all wealth as guilt.
verses.before: people who trust in their wealth and boast in the abundance of their riches?
verses.after: those who trust in their resources and boast of their great wealth?
verses.tsw_comparator: those who trust in their wealth and boast in the abundance of their riches?

verses.rationale: Keep specific brother and inability to redeem.
verses.before: Surely no one can ransom another or give to God the price of a life,
verses.after: No one can ransom a brother or pay God the price for his life—
verses.tsw_comparator: Surely no one can ransom another or give to God the price of a life,

verses.rationale: Preserve parenthetic explanation and absolute inability.
